news.title: Key talking points from Bompastor and Walsh Austria Vienna press conference
news.title_zh: Bompastor 和 Walsh Austria 维也纳新闻发布会的要点
news.body_en: Chelsea head coach Sonia Bompastor and midfielder Keira Walsh faced the media at Cobham ahead of our UEFA Women's Champions League clash with Austria Vienna, and here are the stand-out talking points from their press conference. We return to Plough Lane to take on European opposition in our first league phase game of the competition on Wednesday night, looking to put three points on the board at the first opportunity. The midweek fixture comes off the back of Women's Super League wins against Manchester United and Birmingham City, where we scored a combined seven goals without reply. Austria Vienna have qualified for the Champions League proper for the first time this season, and Walsh and Bompastor gave us some key information ahead of the clash. Sonia Bompastor: It's really exciting to start tomorrow, and we are all ready. I think we have the quality in the team, in the squad, to win this competition. The season will be long. We know we also have a really competitive league here in England. Keeping the players available and fit to perform in any fixture will be a good idea for us. I think it's too soon and too early in the season for us to talk about going all the way through, even if the ambitions are there and we want to do that. We are focusing right now on having a strong start tomorrow. We are playing a home game, and that's really important for us to start with a good performance and a good result. Keira Walsh: It's a massive competition. It's part of why I joined. I think the club's ambition and my ambition is the same: to win the Champions League. But as Sonia said, it's a really difficult competition. Teams are getting better, and it's a very difficult period for us with these games we've got coming up as well. I think the ambition is still there to win it, but I think we've got to take it a game at a time, and you've got to try and compete across three trophies. It's difficult. SB: The game plan is ready. We know the spaces we can use tomorrow on the pitch. We probably also know how we can hurt them. But we have a lot of respect for them because every game will be difficult. We know they are coming tomorrow with no pressure. They are the underdogs, so they have nothing to lose, and it's important for us to be ready. So we are going into the game confident, but not too confident, just the right level. KW: I just prepare for every game the same, whether I know who I'm playing or whether I don't. I think, as Sonia said, they're obviously a good team. They qualified for the Champions League. For me, it's our first game at home, and we want to win it. We go in with the same mindset and mentality to just go win the game. SB: Lexi was performing last season as well. It was just on me to make the decision. She's playing alongside Keira. So they both look good when they play alongside each other. I'm lucky to have two really good English players in those positions. KW:  It's not normally my role to try and get in the box and score. I think when Lexi's playing alongside me, she makes me feel really comfortable, and she gives me the freedom to go and do those things. We've got a great partnership, and I think that's probably where most of my confidence comes from. I'm in the box, and I'm trying to arrive and make a difference that end, and I know that she's gonna sit and have my back at the other end. I think for me it's probably mostly about that. Don't miss our huge London derby clash against Arsenal at Stamford Bridge! Secure your seat now...
news.body_zh: 切尔西主教练索尼娅·邦帕斯托和中场球员凯拉·沃尔什在我们与奥地利维也纳的欧洲女足冠军联赛比赛前在科巴姆接受了媒体采访，以下是他们新闻发布会上的重要谈话要点。我们将返回普劳巷，在周三晚上的第一场联赛阶段比赛中迎战欧洲对手，希望一有机会就拿下三分。周中的比赛是在女足超级联赛战胜曼联和伯明翰城之后进行的，我们在这场比赛中总共打进了 7 个进球，但没有取得进球。奥地利维也纳本赛季首次获得欧冠资格，沃尔什和邦帕斯托在比赛前向我们提供了一些关键信息。 Sonia Bompastor：明天开始真是令人兴奋，我们都准备好了。我认为我们的球队和阵容有能力赢得这场比赛。这个季节将会很长。我们知道英格兰也有一个非常有竞争力的联赛。让球员能够在任何比赛中保持状态并保持健康状态对我们来说是一个好主意。我认为对于我们来说，在赛季中谈论一路走来还为时过早，即使我们有雄心壮志并且我们想要做到这一点。我们现在的重点是明天有一个良好的开端。我们正在主场比赛，对于我们来说，以良好的表现和良好的结果开始非常重要。凯拉·沃尔什：这是一场大规模的竞争。这是我加入的部分原因。我认为俱乐部的野心和我的野心是一样的：赢得欧冠冠军。但正如索尼娅所说，这是一场非常艰难的比赛。球队正在变得越来越好，对于我们来说，这是一个非常困难的时期，因为我们也即将迎来这些比赛。我认为赢得冠军的雄心仍然存在，但我认为我们必须一场一场地比赛，你必须尝试争夺三座奖杯。它很难。 SB：游戏计划已经准备好了。我们知道明天可以在球场上使用的空间。我们可能也知道如何伤害他们。但我们非常尊重他们，因为每场比赛都会很困难。我们知道他们明天会毫无压力地来。他们是弱者，所以他们没有什么可失去的，我们做好准备很重要。所以我们对比赛充满信心，但不是太自信，只是在适当的水平上。 KW：我只是以同样的方式准备每场比赛，无论我是否知道自己在和谁比赛。我认为，正如索尼娅所说，他们显然是一支优秀的团队。他们获得了欧冠资格。对我来说，这是我们在主场的第一场比赛，我们希望赢得比赛。我们以同样的心态和心态去赢得比赛。 SB：莱克西上赛季也表现出色。只有我才能做出决定。她和凯拉一起演奏。所以当他们并肩作战时，他们看起来都很好。我很幸运在这些位置上有两位非常优秀的英国球员。 KW：通常我的角色不是尝试进入禁区并得分。我认为当莱克西和我一起打球时，她让我感觉非常舒服，她给了我去做这些事情的自由。我们拥有良好的合作伙伴关系，我认为这可能是我大部分信心的来源。我在禁区里，我试图到达并在这一端做出改变，我知道她会坐在另一端支持我。我想对我来说这可能主要是关于这个的。不要错过我们在斯坦福桥对阵阿森纳的伦敦德比大战！赶紧抢座位吧……

news.title: Sonia Bompastor provides injury update ahead of Austria Vienna
news.title_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特 (Sonia Bompastor) 在奥地利维也纳赛前提供最新伤病情况
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor was able to provide a positive injury update on three players ahead of our Champions League meeting with Austria Vienna, while she hopes to have Lauren James available for the weekend visit of Arsenal. Chelsea host the Austrian side in our first fixture of this season’s league phase. Kick-off at Plough Lane on Wednesday evening is at 8pm, with tickets for the game still available. Our European opener arrives following the WSL success over Birmingham City and prior to Sunday’s exciting derby against Arsenal at Stamford Bridge. Speaking to the media at Cobham, Bompastor confirmed the target remains for James to return in time for that meeting with our London rivals, after the attacker picked up a small knock in training last Friday. ‘She should be available for the game on the weekend, but we don’t want to take any risks for the game tomorrow,’ said Bompastor. ‘She’s a bit short.’ Meanwhile, Bompastor was pleased to confirm that Erin Cuthbert and Manaka Matsukubo are back on the grass having yet to feature this season. So is Aggie Beever-Jones, who missed the weekend win over Birmingham, although the trio aren’t yet ready to return to match action. ‘They are training again with the team, so a lot of players and it’s good news. Manaka is back in training, not fully fit yet, but it’s good to have her back. ‘It’s really good to see Erin back. I’m always happy when I have most of my players on the pitch. It brings positivity around the team and the quality on the pitch progresses. ‘It’s always good to have that competition in the squad, and everyone being happy to be on the pitch together.’ Naomi Girma returned to the matchday squad when we beat Birmingham having picked up a small injury the week before. Bompastor was asked where the American is at fitness wise and how much she will be involved in the coming, busy weeks ahead. ‘She’s an important player for us,’ replied Bompastor. ‘She has a lot of experience for us and for the US as well. ‘We are trying to work with her to be on the pitch as much as possible. When we get that right, you will see the best of her. She’s a great player and a great leader. ‘This league is very demanding in terms of physicality, and it’s a new club for her so we are trying to have everything right around her for her to be able to stay on the pitch,' added Bompastor. 'She’s been a little bit unlucky with some of the injuries she has got, but I am confident she will get there and be an important player for us.’
news.body_zh: 在我们与奥地利维也纳的冠军联赛比赛之前，索尼娅·邦帕斯特能够提供三名球员的积极伤情更新，同时她希望劳伦·詹姆斯能够参加周末对阿森纳的比赛。切尔西在本赛季联赛阶段的第一场比赛中主场迎战奥地利球队。周三晚上 8 点在 Plough Lane 开球，比赛门票仍有售。我们的欧洲揭幕战将在 WSL 战胜伯明翰城之后、周日在斯坦福桥对阵阿森纳的激动人心的德比战之前到来。邦帕斯托在科巴姆接受媒体采访时证实，在上周五的训练中受伤后，詹姆斯的目标仍然是及时回归，参加与我们伦敦对手的比赛。 “她应该可以参加周末的比赛，但我们不想为明天的比赛冒任何风险，”邦帕斯特说。 “她有点矮。”与此同时，邦帕斯特很高兴地确认艾琳·库斯伯特和马纳卡·松久保在本赛季尚未出场的情况下重返草地。阿吉·比弗-琼斯也是如此，他错过了周末对阵伯明翰的比赛，尽管三人组还没有准备好重返比赛。 “他们再次与球队一起训练，有很多球员，这是个好消息。玛娜卡已经回到训练中，虽然还没有完全康复，但她回来真是太好了。 “很高兴看到艾琳回来。当我的大部分球员都在场上时，我总是很高兴。它给球队带来了积极性，球场上的质量也不断提高。 “球队里有这样的竞争总是好事，每个人都很高兴能一起上场。”当我们击败伯明翰队时，内奥米·吉尔玛在一周前受了点小伤，回到了比赛日阵容。邦帕斯特被问及这位美国人的健康状况如何，以及她将在接下来的忙碌几周中参与多少活动。 “她对我们来说是一位重要的球员，”邦帕斯特回答道。 “她对我们和美国都有丰富的经验。 “我们正在努力与她合作，尽可能多地出现在球场上。当我们做到这一点时，你会看到她最好的一面。她是一位伟大的球员，也是一位伟大的领导者。 “这个联赛对身体素质的要求非常高，对她来说这是一个新俱乐部，所以我们正在努力为她提供一切便利，以便她能够留在球场上，”邦帕斯特补充道。 “她受到的一些伤病有点不幸，但我相信她会到达那里并成为我们的重要球员。”

news.title: Maika Hamano reaches appearance milestone for Chelsea
news.title_zh: 滨野麻香 (Maika Hamano) 达到切尔西出场里程碑
news.body_en: Maika Hamano completed a half-century of appearances for Chelsea when she was introduced as a 72nd-minute substitute in our 2-0 victory over Birmingham City last Saturday. Hamano joined the Blues as a teenager from INAC Kobe Leonessa of the WE League in her home country of Japan in January 2023. That season, she would win her first Women's Super League title, before the following campaign saw her contribute to our domestic Treble with 30 appearances and six goals under new head coach Sonia Bompastor. In 2025/26, the Japanese international made eight appearances in blue before heading to Tottenham Hotspur on loan, where she spent the rest of the season under the tutelage of Spurs' head coach Martin Ho. In March, she was called up to Japan's Asian Cup squad, standing out as a star performer. Hamano featured in five of Japan's six matches at the tournament, scoring three times in total as they reached the final against home nation Australia. A cagey affair followed, and Hamano netted the only goal of the game in a 1-0 win that saw her named in the inaugural edition of the FIFPRO Asia/Oceania Team of the Tournament for the 2026 Women’s Asian Cup. Now back with Chelsea, Hamano has made four appearances so far this season, marking her 50th with the club during our 2-0 win over Birmingham City. Don't miss our huge London derby clash against Arsenal at Stamford Bridge! Secure your seat now...
news.body_zh: 上周六，滨野麻香在切尔西 2-0 战胜伯明翰城的比赛中，第 72 分钟替补上场，完成了半个世纪的切尔西出场生涯。滨野于 2023 年 1 月从祖国日本 WE 联赛的 INAC 神户莱昂内萨 (INAC Kobe Leonessa) 加盟蓝军。那个赛季，她赢得了她的第一个女子超级联赛冠军，随后在接下来的赛季中，她在新任主教练索尼娅·邦帕斯特 (Sonia Bompastor) 的带领下，以 30 场出场和 6 个进球为我们的国内三冠王做出了贡献。 2025/26赛季，这位日本国脚身穿蓝色球衣出场八次，然后被租借至托特纳姆热刺，并在热刺主教练马丁·何的指导下度过了整个赛季。 3月，她入选日本亚洲杯大名单，表现出色。滨野在日本队参加的六场比赛中出场了五场，总共打入三球，并在决赛中对阵祖国澳大利亚。接下来是一场谨慎的比赛，滨野以 1-0 的比分攻入全场唯一进球，并入选 2026 年女子亚洲杯首届 FIFPRO 亚洲/大洋洲锦标赛团体赛。现在回到切尔西，滨野本赛季到目前为止已经出场四次，在我们 2-0 战胜伯明翰城的比赛中，这是她为俱乐部出场的第 50 次。不要错过我们在斯坦福桥对阵阿森纳的伦敦德比大战！赶紧抢座位吧……

news.title: Chelsea Women vs Austria Vienna: How to watch, kick-off time, live stream info
news.title_zh: 切尔西女足 vs 奥地利维也纳：如何观看、开球时间、直播信息
news.body_en: Chelsea Women kick off our league phase campaign in this season's UEFA Women's Champions League by hosting Austria Vienna in west London. After successfully negotiating a two-legged qualifying play-off against Spanish side Real Sociedad, the Champions League proper begins with a home tie against unfamiliar opposition for the Blues, looking to start by getting an important three points on the board. Here is everything you need to know about how to watch Chelsea Women against Austria Vienna, including kick-off time and how to follow the action on official Chelsea channels. Chelsea Women's game against Austria Vienna takes place on Wednesday 23 September 2026 at Plough Lane, with kick-off scheduled for 8pm UK time. Tickets for the game remain on sale. If you can't make it to Plough Lane, then you can watch the match live on Disney+. As always, team news, live updates and match coverage will be provided in our Chelsea Women vs Austria Vienna Match Centre on the Chelsea Official App and Chelsea website. You can also follow Chelsea Women’s social media channels on X, Facebook, Instagram and TikTok. Chelsea have a 100 per cent record in European football this season after winning both legs of our Champions League qualifying play-off against Real Sociedad. Since then, we recovered well from being held to a draw by Aston Villa on the opening day of the Women's Super League by recording back-to-back wins over Manchester United and Birmingham City. Austria Vienna are making their debut in this stage of the competition after coming through three qualifying rounds already this season. They began with victories over Hajduk Split and Farul Constanta in one-off ties, before fighting back from a 2-1 first leg defeat to Brann to win 5-2 on aggregate in the last round. This is the first time Chelsea Women and Austria Vienna have met each other, and the latter's first-ever fixture against an English team full stop. The Blues have faced an Austrian side once previously, though. That was in the same stage of this competition last season, when we beat St Polten 6-0 away from home in November. Catarina Macario and Sam Kerr got two goals each, alongside a strike by Wieke Kaptein and an own goal.
news.body_zh: 切尔西女足在伦敦西部迎战奥地利维也纳，拉开了本赛季欧洲女子冠军联赛联赛阶段的序幕。在成功与西班牙皇家社会队进行两回合预选赛附加赛后，蓝军将在主场迎战陌生的对手，希望以全取重要的三分开始欧冠联赛。以下是您需要了解的有关如何观看切尔西女足对阵奥地利维也纳的所有信息，包括开球时间以及如何关注切尔西官方频道的比赛。切尔西女足对阵奥地利维也纳的比赛将于 2026 年 9 月 23 日星期三在 Plough Lane 举行，开球时间定于英国时间晚上 8 点。比赛门票仍在销售中。如果您无法前往 Plough Lane，则可以在 Disney+ 上观看比赛直播。与往常一样，球队新闻、实时更新和比赛报道将在切尔西官方应用程序和切尔西网站上的切尔西女足对阵奥地利维也纳比赛中心提供。您还可以在 X、Facebook、Instagram 和 TikTok 上关注切尔西女足的社交媒体频道。切尔西在欧冠资格赛附加赛对阵皇家社会的两回合比赛中获胜，本赛季欧洲足坛的战绩为 100%。此后，我们从女超揭幕战被阿斯顿维拉逼平的局面中恢复过来，连续战胜了曼联和伯明翰城。奥地利维也纳队在本赛季已经经历了三轮预选赛后，将在这一阶段的比赛中首次亮相。他们先是一次性战胜了斯普利特海杜克和康斯坦察法鲁尔，然后在首回合1-2负于布莱恩的情况下奋起反击，最后一轮以总比分5-2获胜。这是切尔西女足和奥地利维也纳队的首次交手，也是后者首次对阵英格兰队。不过，蓝军此前曾对阵过奥地利球队。那是上赛季这项赛事的同一阶段，11月份我们客场6-0击败圣波尔滕。卡塔琳娜·马卡里奥和萨姆·克尔各进两球，此外维克·卡普坦的进球和乌龙球。

news.title: From the archive: The six Chelsea games Thiago Silva will always remember
news.title_zh: 来自档案：蒂亚戈·席尔瓦将永远记住的六场切尔西比赛
news.body_en: To celebrate Thiago Silva's 42nd birthday, we look back at an interview we conducted with the Brazilian, when the defender talked us through his most memorable matches for Chelsea... Thiago Silva only expected to stay a year at Chelsea after joining on a free transfer at the age of 35. That he remained for four seasons and was a key figure throughout is testament to his quality and longevity. The Brazilian quickly forged a strong bond with Blues supporters, who recognised the class with which Thiago behaved on and off the pitch. Victories were celebrated, trophies were lifted and lasting memories were created, before Thiago Silva brought the curtain down on his time at Chelsea to return home to Brazil. He will be remembered as a Chelsea great and one of the best defenders of his generation. 'My first game for Chelsea. I remember well. The opportunity to wear the shirt was a big responsibility. I felt that. But in this game, I was also given the captain's armband by [Frank] Lampard. 'That was the positive. Then there is the negative, I think Chelsea fans will remember. I made a big mistake, practically gave a goal away. It was not my best moment, but it was important. 'It made me grow and helped me realise that this league, the Premier League, was different from what I had come from. It made me understand.' 'Special day. Obviously, because of the pandemic, we had been playing without supporters in the stadium. I had felt the love of the Chelsea fans through social media but to have 8,000 in Stamford Bridge was different. 'The noise! I remember it felt like there were 45,000 fans in the stadium that night. I was touched by that – and it gave me a real feeling that we were getting back to normality. 'That we also won for those supporters meant it was a good day for us.' 'I smile when I see this picture. The year before, when I was with Paris, I lost the final. Then I changed clubs and in my first season achieved this dream. You think: "How can it happen in this way?!" Only God has the answers and knows the moments. 'Of course, it was not the game I expected as I got injured in the first half. We all have an ego and we all want to play in these games – a Champions League final! – but my ego in relation to what my team-mates and the club needed wasn't important at that moment. 'I could have continued but I wasn't 100 per cent able to help the team. So I decided with [Thomas] Tuchel to come off and for Andreas [Christensen] to come in. He had a brilliant season so it felt right, and he did so well. 'It was not easy watching, but I felt so happy and as if I had played the 90 minutes! What a crazy day.' 'A brilliant performance away at our biggest rivals. Something like that isn’t simple to do and it always means a good feeling for the players and the fans. 'We played well, the performance was convincing. We had a clean sheet and I scored our first goal. I think everything that could have gone well for us in this game happened. 'I think the worst thing when I think back on this game was my hair! It was something I had to do for a sponsor in Brazil – but I think it turned out to be good luck because the goal I scored was with my head! 'As is the case for any Brazilian player, to win this title is a surreal feeling. Every club in Brazil dreams about winning this title. Every one. For me, it was the same thing, even though I was playing for a European club. 'I know some people say that clubs in Europe are not as focused on this competition, that it is just another competition to win. So I wanted to make sure the team was motivated to win this trophy. 'The final was not easy – and I remember we did the warm-up in front of the Palmeiras fans! But we made sure that we won the game and I was very proud to be named the player of the match in the final and the player of the tournament. 'It is one of the most important trophies of my career and the first Club World Cup for Chelsea.' 'A very emotional day and a very special day for me. I spent three-and-a-half years playing for Milan and it was only 10 years later that I had the chance to return. It never happened with Paris. 'I came out onto the pitch at San Siro and all the fans were chanting my name. During the game, I could hear people around the stadium shouting my name. It was a touching experience 'We had a good performance that night and won the game. We kept a clean sheet too. At the end of the match, I did almost an Olympic lap to thank the Milan and Chelsea supporters. 'I never got the chance to thank the fans at Milan, so that was a nice moment. As was the match at Stamford Bridge against them – we had another clean sheet! 'I also remember well the game against Juventus in the Champions League. That is when I did the goal-line clearance from [Alvaro] Morata, that has stayed in my mind. Tuchel insisted after I had plenty of space, that I could've played a pass! 'But every match that I played for this club – more than 150 games – they all somehow have marked me as special.'
news.body_zh: 为了庆祝蒂亚戈·席尔瓦的 42 岁生日，我们回顾一下对这位巴西人进行的采访，当时这位后卫向我们讲述了他在切尔西最难忘的比赛……蒂亚戈·席尔瓦在 35 岁自由转会加盟切尔西后只预计在切尔西呆一年。他在切尔西待了四个赛季，并且始终是关键人物，这证明了他的能力和寿命。巴西人很快与蓝军球迷建立了牢固的联系，他们认可蒂亚戈在球场内外的表现。在蒂亚戈·席尔瓦结束他在切尔西的时光回到巴西之前，人们庆祝了胜利，举起了奖杯，创造了持久的回忆。他将作为切尔西的伟大球员和同代人中最好的后卫之一而被人们铭记。 “我为切尔西踢的第一场比赛。我记得很清楚。穿上这件球衣的机会意味着巨大的责任。我感觉到了。但在这场比赛中，我也被兰帕德授予了队长袖标。 '这是积极的一面。然后是负面的，我想切尔西球迷会记得。我犯了一个很大的错误，几乎丢掉了一个进球。这不是我最好的时刻，但它很重要。 “这让我成长并帮助我意识到这个联赛，英超联赛，与我来自的地方不同。这让我明白了。 '特别的一天。显然，由于疫情的原因，我们在体育场内进行了没有球迷支持的比赛。我通过社交媒体感受到了切尔西球迷的爱，但在斯坦福桥拥有 8,000 名球迷是不同的。 '噪音！我记得那天晚上体育场里有 45,000 名球迷。我对此很感动——这给了我一种我们正在恢复正常的真实感觉。 “我们也为那些支持者赢得了胜利，这对我们来说是美好的一天。” '当我看到这张照片时我笑了。前一年，当我在巴黎时，我输掉了决赛。然后我换了俱乐部，并在第一个赛季实现了这个梦想。你想：“怎么会这样呢？！”只有上帝有答案并知道那些时刻。 “当然，这不是我期望的比赛，因为我在上半场受伤了。我们都有自我意识，我们都想参加这些比赛——欧冠决赛！ – 但在那一刻，我的自我意识对于我的队友和俱乐部的需求并不重要。 “我本可以继续，但我不能百分百能够帮助球队。所以我决定让[托马斯]图赫尔下场，让安德烈亚斯[克里斯滕森]上场。他度过了一个辉煌的赛季，所以感觉不错，而且他做得很好。 “观看比赛并不容易，但我感到很高兴，就好像我已经踢完了90分钟！多么疯狂的一天啊。 “客场对阵我们最大的对手，表现非常出色。这样的事情做起来并不容易，但它总是意味着球员和球迷的良好感觉。 “我们打得很好，表现令人信服。我们零失球，我打进了我们的第一个进球。我认为这场比赛中我们本可以顺利进行的一切都发生了。 “当我回想起这场比赛时，我认为最糟糕的是我的头发！这是我必须为巴西的赞助商做的事情 - 但我认为结果是运气好，因为我的进球是用我的头！ “对于任何巴西球员来说，赢得这个冠军都是一种超现实的感觉。巴西的每个俱乐部都梦想赢得这个冠军。每个人。对我来说，这是同样的事情，即使我在欧洲俱乐部踢球。 “我知道有些人说欧洲的俱乐部并不那么关注这场比赛，这只是另一场需要获胜的比赛。所以我想确保球队有动力赢得这座奖杯。 “决赛并不容易——我记得我们在帕尔梅拉斯球迷面前做了热身！但我们确保赢得了比赛，我很自豪能够被评为决赛最佳球员和锦标赛最佳球员。 “这是我职业生涯中最重要的奖杯之一，也是切尔西的第一座世俱杯。” “这是非常激动人心的一天，对我来说也是非常特别的一天。我为米兰效力了三年半，直到十年后我才有机会回归。巴黎从来没有发生过这种事。 “我来到圣西罗球场，所有球迷都在高喊我的名字。比赛期间，我能听到体育场周围的人们喊着我的名字。这是一次感人的经历：“那天晚上我们表现出色，赢得了比赛。我们也保持了零失球。比赛结束时，我几乎跑了一圈奥运圈来感谢米兰和切尔西的支持者。 “我从来没有机会感谢米兰的球迷，所以那是一个美好的时刻。正如在斯坦福桥对阵他们的比赛一样——我们再次零失球！ “我还清楚地记得欧冠对阵尤文图斯的比赛。就在我从[阿尔瓦罗]莫拉塔球门线解围的时候，那件事一直留在我的脑海里。图赫尔在我有足够的空间后坚持认为我可以传球！ “但我为俱乐部踢的每一场比赛——超过 150 场比赛——都以某种方式让我显得很特别。”

news.title: Chelsea’s youngest ever players
news.title_zh: 切尔西历史上最年轻的球员
news.body_en: Mahdi Nicoll-Jazuli became Chelsea’s youngest-ever Premier League player last week and the second 16-year-old to make his senior debut already this season. Here we look at the rest of the Blues’ all-time list of youngest players. Nicoll-Jazuli and Reggie Watson were both involved for Xabi Alonso’s team during pre-season before being handed their competitive debuts by our Spanish manager in the last couple of weeks. Those two Academy midfielders became the eighth and ninth 16-year-olds to have appeared for Chelsea’s senior team in competitive action. This is the full list… Ian 'Chico' Hamilton remains our youngest ever player. While still a junior, he was handed his senior debut in a league game against Tottenham at White Hart Lane in March 1967, and headed the Chelsea goal in a 1-1 draw. It was the first of five appearances Hamilton made for the Blues. Welsh goalkeeper Kingsley Whiffen was brought into the Chelsea side for our final league fixture of 1966/67 as manager Tommy Docherty opted to rest Peter Bonetti ahead of the impending FA Cup final. It would prove his only Chelsea game. Academy midfielder Reggie Walsh was a regular in our UEFA Conference League squads during the 2024/25 season and was brought off the bench for the first time in the 88th minute of the win away to Djurgarden. Reggie Watson’s debut came from the start, as the Academy graduate played the first half of Chelsea’s meeting with Leeds United at Stamford Bridge. That was in this season's Carabao Cup third round, when the Blues fought back from 2-0 down to win a thrilling tie 6-3. Young midfielder Mahdi Nicoll-Jazuli’s debut arrived last Friday, when he came off the bench late on to replace Valentin Barco in a west London derby, as we made the short trip across the capital to Brentford in the Premier League. Boyhood Blues fan Tommy Langley is the player with the most Chelsea appearances on this list. He made his debut in November 1974 and in total played 152 times for us over the course of six seasons, scoring 43 goals. Michael Woods made his Chelsea debut as a substitute in a big FA Cup win over Macclesfield in January 2007. The midfielder featured once more for us in that competition and eventually left the club in 2011. He has most recently been at Morpeth Town. John Sparrow broke through during the 1973/74 season and played for us in six different campaigns. He scored twice in 74 appearances in blue before joining Exeter City in January 1981. Michael Harrison debuted for Chelsea against Blackpool in April 1957, shortly before turning 17. The left winger went on to play 64 times for us between then and September 1962 before joining Blackburn Rovers.
news.body_zh: 马赫迪·尼科尔-贾祖利上周成为切尔西队史上最年轻的英超球员，也是本赛季第二位完成成年队首秀的 16 岁球员。下面我们来看看蓝军历史上其他最年轻球员的名单。尼科尔-贾祖利和雷吉·沃森都曾在季前赛中为哈维·阿隆索的球队效力，但在过去几周里，我们的西班牙主教练让他们首次亮相正式比赛。这两名青训球员成为第八位和第九位代表切尔西成年队参加正式比赛的 16 岁球员。这是完整名单……伊恩·“奇科”·汉密尔顿仍然是我们有史以来最年轻的球员。 1967 年 3 月，当他还是一名青少年球员时，他就在白鹿巷球场对阵托特纳姆热刺的联赛中首次亮相，并在切尔西 1-1 战平的比赛中头球破门。这是汉密尔顿为蓝军出场五次中的第一次。威尔士门将金斯利·惠芬被带入切尔西队参加 1966/67 年最后一场联赛，主教练汤米·多切蒂选择在即将到来的足总杯决赛之前让彼得·博内蒂休息。这将证明他在切尔西的唯一一场比赛。青训中场球员雷吉·沃尔什是 2024/25 赛季欧洲联盟会议联赛球队的常客，并在客场战胜尤尔加登队的比赛第 88 分钟首次替补出场。雷吉·沃森从一开始就完成了首秀，这位青训毕业生在斯坦福桥切尔西与利兹联的比赛中踢了上半场比赛。那是在本赛季联赛杯第三轮比赛中，蓝军在0-2落后的情况下奋起反击，以6-3惊心动魄地赢得了比赛。年轻的中场球员迈赫迪·尼科尔-贾祖利上周五首次亮相，当时他在一场西伦敦德比中替补出场，取代瓦伦丁·巴尔科，当时我们正在穿越首都前往英超联赛的布伦特福德。童年时期的蓝军球迷汤米·兰利是这份名单上为切尔西出场次数最多的球员。他于1974年11月首次亮相，在六个赛季中总共为我们出场152次，攻入43球。 2007 年 1 月，迈克尔·伍兹在足总杯战胜麦克尔斯菲尔德的比赛中替补完成了他的切尔西首秀。这位中场球员在那场比赛中再次代表我们出场，并最终于 2011 年离开了俱乐部。他最近效力于莫珀斯镇。约翰·斯帕罗 (John Sparrow) 在 1973/74 赛季取得突破，并为我们效力了六个不同的赛季。在 1981 年 1 月加盟埃克塞特城之前，他在 74 场比赛中攻入两球。迈克尔·哈里森 (Michael Harrison) 在 1957 年 4 月对阵布莱克浦的比赛中首次代表切尔西出场，当时他就年满 17 岁了。从那时起到 1962 年 9 月，这位左翼边锋为我们出场 64 次，之后加盟布莱克本流浪者队。

news.title: PGA South League report: Chelsea Women Under-18s 0-2 Arsenal Under-21s
news.title_zh: PGA 南联盟报告：切尔西 18 岁以下女子队 0-2 阿森纳 21 岁以下女子队
news.body_en: Chelsea Women's Under-18s, who play in the PGA Under-21 Women's League, suffered our first defeat of the season as Arsenal Under-21s recorded a 2-0 victory at Kingsmeadow. The Blues performed well in their first fixture at Kingsmeadow this term, with possession fairly evenly split and Chelsea creating more opportunities on goal. However, two second-half goals saw Arsenal take the points. The Blues continued to compete until the final whistle despite falling behind, with Leanne Champ's side unable to find a way through the visitors' defence. The opening half was closely contested, with neither side finding a breakthrough before the interval. Chelsea worked to create chances against a resolute Arsenal defence, with the Blues looking to build attacks and make the most of their possession. Yet there was no reward for the hosts before the break as the two teams went into half-time level. Arsenal took the lead after 58 minutes. An inswinging corner was met first by Keira Johnson, who reacted to clear the ball. However, it only reached an Arsenal player on the edge of the penalty area, who brought the ball under control before striking powerfully beyond Freya Weeks to put the visitors ahead. Chelsea made a double change after 63 minutes, with Aysia Matabaro and Carla Gardiner replacing Rebekah Pierce and Chelsea N'Drin. The Blues continued to battle for an equaliser but Arsenal doubled their advantage with 17 minutes remaining. A free-kick was awarded 30 yards from goal following a challenge from Annie Boichat. The defender was shown a yellow card, with Arsenal's No.56 taking responsibility for the set-piece. Her strike dipped high into the right-hand side of Weeks' goal to make it 2-0. Chelsea continued to perform and fight until the end but could not find a way back into the match. The result brings Chelsea's unbeaten start to the PGA Under-21 Women's League season to an end after four victories from our opening four fixtures. Chelsea return to Kingsmeadow on Wednesday 23 September when we face Ipswich Town in the PGA Under-21 Women's League. The fixture is behind closed doors. Chelsea (4-3-3): Freya Weeks; Elise Christian, Annie Boichat, Gabi Storey, Zoe Ciccardini; Belle Sullivan (c), Stevie Sinclair, Keira Johnson; Rebekah Pierce (Aysia Matabaro 63’), Chelsea N’Drin (Carla Gardiner 63’), Jahmya Putman Booked: 35’ N’Drin. 72’ Boichat. 78’ Storey
news.body_zh: 参加 PGA 21 岁以下女子联赛的切尔西 18 岁以下女子队遭遇本赛季首场失利，阿森纳 21 岁以下队在金斯梅多以 2-0 获胜。蓝军本赛季在金斯梅多的首场比赛表现出色，控球率相当均匀，切尔西创造了更多进球机会。然而，下半场的两个进球帮助阿森纳取得了积分。尽管落后，蓝军仍继续比赛直到终场哨声响起，而莉安·钱普的球队无法找到突破客队防线的方法。上半场双方争夺激烈，中场休息前双方均未取得突破。面对阿森纳顽强的防守，切尔西努力创造机会，而蓝军则希望发起进攻并充分利用控球权。然而中场休息前主队并没有获得任何奖励，两队半场打成平手。第58分钟，阿森纳取得领先。凯拉·约翰逊首先接到内旋角球，她做出反应将球解围。然而，球只传到了禁区边缘的一名阿森纳球员手中，后者控制住了球，然后大力射门越过弗雷亚·维克斯，帮助客队取得领先。第63分钟，切尔西进行了两次换人，艾西亚·马塔巴罗和卡拉·加德纳取代了丽贝卡·皮尔斯和切尔西·恩德林。蓝军继续为扳平比分而战，但阿森纳在比赛还剩17分钟时将优势扩大一倍。安妮·博伊夏 (Annie Boichat) 犯规后，在距球门 30 码处获得任意球。这名后卫被出示黄牌，阿森纳 56 号球员承担了定位球的责任。她的射门高出威克斯球门右侧，将比分改写为2-0。切尔西继续表现并战斗到最后，但未能找到重返比赛的方法。这一结果结束了切尔西在 PGA 21 岁以下女子联赛赛季中的不败开局，此前我们在前四场比赛中取得了四场胜利。切尔西将于 9 月 23 日星期三重返 Kingsmeadow，届时我们将在 PGA 21 岁以下女子联赛中对阵伊普斯维奇镇。比赛是闭门进行的。切尔西（4-3-3）：弗雷亚·维克斯；埃莉斯·克里斯蒂安、安妮·博伊查特、加比·斯托里、佐伊·西卡迪尼；贝尔·沙利文 (c)、史蒂维·辛克莱、凯拉·约翰逊；丽贝卡·皮尔斯（艾西亚·马塔巴罗 63 分钟）、切尔西·恩德林（卡拉·加德纳 63 分钟）、贾米亚·普特曼 黄牌：35 分钟恩德林。 72' 博伊夏。 78’层高

news.title: Morgan Rogers Unlocked – coming this Thursday
news.title_zh: 摩根罗杰斯解锁 - 本周四推出
news.body_en: Morgan Rogers joins us in the latest episode of CFC Unlocked and explains exclusively to CFC+ subscribers how he was shaped during his early career to become the game-changing player you now see at Chelsea. The full episode of Rogers’ CFC Unlocked appearance is coming soon exclusively for CFC+ subscribers, but in the meantime you can get a sneak peak of what is to come in the trailer below. Sitting down for an in-depth chat at Cobham, our summer signing shares his unorthodox journey from playing alongside friend Cole Palmer in the Manchester City youth system to joining him at Chelsea, via a tour of the Football League. Rogers also explains how those experiences have shaped him as a person and a player, resulting in the creative playmaker who can now be seen making a big impact on the pitch for the Blues and the England national team. Morgan goes on to speak about much more than football, though. He also turns agony aunt by trying to solve supporters’ personal dilemmas, including his tips on dating at Stamford Bridge and how to handle that friend who insists they would have made it as a professional footballer if they hadn’t suffered an injury. news.title: Three Women’s Super League matches at the Bridge now on sale

news.body_en: With the Barclays WSL season now properly underway, three more of this season’s games to be played at Stamford Bridge now have their tickets on sale. Sonia Bompastor’s side recorded their second win in this season’s competition at weekend with a 2-0 victory at home to Birmingham. There are two more home matches this week with the Blues playing in the Women's Champions League on Wednesday at AFC Wimbledon and then back at the Bridge on Sunday when we take on Arsenal (tickets for both games are available here). Further on the horizon are three home fixtures in November and December. All are yet to have their dates and kick-off times confirmed but over the weekend of 7 and 8 November we welcome Everton, and the following weekend we take on the team we are aiming to reclaim the league crown from, Manchester City. Those are followed by a derby against London City Lionesses on the weekend of 12/13 December. Ticket sales for these matches will be as follows (supporters can purchase up to 20 tickets per transaction): For all three matches, early-bird tickets will be on sale from 2pm on Monday 21 September. For all three matches, general sale tickets will be on sale from 2pm on Monday 28 September. For the match versus Everton, last chance to buy tickets will be on sale from 12pm on Wednesday 4 November. For the match versus Manchester City, last chance to buy tickets will be on sale from 12pm on Wednesday 11 November. For the match versus London City Lionesses, last chance to buy tickets will be on sale from 12pm on Wednesday 9 December. Supporters who hold a Bridge Pass will not need to purchase tickets for the Manchester City and London City Lionesses games as these fixture are covered in the pass. Tickets will be sold online only and are for Chelsea supporters only. They are initially available to purchase in the entirety of the lower bowl except for the Everton game where they are initially available to purchase in the West lower and Shed lower. Premium tickets are available to purchase by selecting the Pitch View Lounge in blocks 1 and 2 of the Shed Lower. Alcoholic drinks purchased in the stadium will be allowed in all areas of the stadium except the alcohol-free stands in blocks 1 and 2 of the West Lower. news.title: Chelsea Diary: European nights and London derby await
news.title_zh: 切尔西日记：欧洲之夜和伦敦德比等待着
news.body_en: Champions League football, a big London derby at Stamford Bridge and a new episode of Unlocked await Chelsea supporters this week, while several Blues begin their international campaigns. Chelsea Women face Austria Vienna before welcoming Arsenal to the Bridge, with our Women's Under-18s also in league action. There are no fixtures scheduled for our men's team, Cobham Next Gen or men's Under-18s between Monday 21 and Sunday 27 September, but we will keep you up to date with how our players representing their countries get on during the extended international window. A big week for Chelsea Women begins with Sonia Bompastor talking about the almost telepathic connection between Keira Walsh and Lexi Potter. Attention will then turn to Wednesday's UEFA Women's Champions League meeting with Austria Vienna at Plough Lane. Meanwhile, the men's international break gets underway. You can find the latest call-ups and schedules on our website and the Chelsea Official App as the Blues prepare to join up with their national teams. You will be able to watch 15 minutes of live Chelsea Women's training on our website and app from 11.30am ahead of the game with Austria Vienna. We will then hear from Bompastor and one of her players when they speak to the media at 3pm. You will be able to watch a stream of the pre-match press conference and 15 minutes of training live on the Chelsea Official App and website. It's a European matchday for the Blues! Chelsea Women host Austria Vienna at Plough Lane, with kick-off at 8pm as our Champions League league-phase campaign begins. We will bring you the build-up and team news, followed by updates in our Match Centre on the Chelsea Official App and website, a match report and reaction from Bompastor and her players. Before that, Chelsea Women's Under-18s, who play in the PGA Under-21 Women's League, welcome Ipswich Town to Kingsmeadow for a 2pm kick-off. There is a new episode of Unlocked to look forward to, with Morgan Rogers taking centre stage in the latest instalment. You can watch all 11 of the previous episodes in the Watch section on our website and app with a CFC+ subscription. We will also bring you more reaction to Wednesday's Champions League match as Chelsea Women begin to turn their attention to Arsenal. On the international stage, Jorrel Hato's Netherlands host Germany and Pedro Neto's Portugal welcome Wales in the Nations League. Both games kick off at 7.45pm, and we will report on any Chelsea involvement. The countdown to Sunday's London derby gathers pace, with our build-up to Chelsea Women against Arsenal continuing and Sonia Bompastor speaking to the media. You will be able to watch her press conference live. It is an early start for those following Estevao Willian, with Brazil facing Australia at 7am UK time. Later, Romeo Lavia and Mike Penders' Belgium visit Italy, while Maxence Lacroix's France travel to Turkiye under the guidance of new manager Zinedine Zidane. Both Nations League fixtures begin at 7.45pm. With just one day to go, we will bring you more pre-match build-up ahead of Chelsea Women's meeting with Arsenal, setting the scene for a big afternoon at the Bridge. That will include words from Lucy Bronze, Sjoeke Nusken and Lauren James about the significance of the London rivalry. There could also be Chelsea representation at Wembley, where Cole Palmer and Morgan Rogers' England face Spain in the Nations League at 7.45pm. London derby day at Stamford Bridge! Chelsea Women take on Arsenal in the Women's Super League, with kick-off at 4.30pm. Tickets are still available to buy, while if you can't get down to the Bridge, supporters in the UK can watch the game live on Sky Sports or you can follow the action with us. Our Chelsea Women vs Arsenal Match Centre on the Chelsea Official App and website will bring you the build-up, team news and minute-by-minute updates, followed by a match report and reaction after the final whistle. There is international action, too: Hato's Netherlands visit Serbia at 5pm, before Neto's Portugal face Norway away at 7.45pm.
news.body_zh: 欧洲冠军联赛、斯坦福桥的大型伦敦德比以及新一集的《Unlocked》本周都在等待着切尔西的支持者，同时几支蓝军也开始了他们的国际比赛。切尔西女足将迎战奥地利维也纳队，然后在蓝桥迎战阿森纳队，我们的 18 岁以下女足队也将参加联赛。 9 月 21 日星期一至 27 日星期日期间，我们的男子球队、Cobham Next Gen 或男子 18 岁以下男子队没有比赛安排，但我们会及时向您通报我们代表各自国家的球员在延长的国际比赛窗口期间的表现。对于切尔西女足来说，重要的一周从索尼娅·邦帕斯特谈论凯拉·沃尔什和莱克西·波特之间近乎心灵感应的联系开始。然后注意力将转向周三在普劳巷举行的欧洲女子冠军联赛与奥地利维也纳的比赛。与此同时，男子国际比赛也开始进行。当蓝军准备与国家队会合时，您可以在我们的网站和切尔西官方应用程序上找到最新的征召和赛程表。在与奥地利维也纳队的比赛之前，您可以从上午 11.30 开始在我们的网站和应用程序上观看切尔西女足 15 分钟的现场训练。下午 3 点，我们将听到 Bompastor 和她的一名球员向媒体发表讲话。您将能够在切尔西官方应用程序和网站上观看赛前新闻发布会和 15 分钟训练的直播。这是蓝军的欧洲比赛日！切尔西女足将在 Plough Lane 主场迎战奥地利维也纳队，比赛将于晚上 8 点开球，同时我们的欧冠联赛阶段比赛也将开始。我们将为您带来集结和球队新闻，然后是切尔西官方应用程序和网站上比赛中心的更新、比赛报告以及邦帕斯特和她的球员的反应。在此之前，参加 PGA 21 岁以下女子联赛的切尔西 18 岁以下女子队将于下午 2 点在金斯梅多迎战伊普斯维奇镇队。 《解锁》新一集值得期待，摩根·罗杰斯将在最新一期中占据中心舞台。通过 CFC+ 订阅，您可以在我们网站和应用程序的“观看”部分观看之前的所有 11 集。随着切尔西女足开始将注意力转向阿森纳，我们还将为您带来对周三冠军联赛比赛的更多反应。在国际舞台上，乔雷尔·哈托 (Jorrel Hato) 的荷兰队将在国家联赛中迎战德国队，佩德罗·内托 (Pedro Neto) 队的葡萄牙队将迎战威尔士队。两场比赛均于晚上 7.45 开始，我们将报告切尔西的任何参与情况。周日伦敦德比的倒计时加快了步伐，切尔西女足对阵阿森纳的备战工作仍在继续，索尼娅·邦帕斯特接受了媒体采访。您将能够现场观看她的新闻发布会。对于追随埃斯特沃·威廉的球迷来说，这是一个较早的开始，巴西队将在英国时间早上 7 点迎战澳大利亚队。随后，罗密欧·拉维亚和迈克·彭德斯率领的比利时队访问了意大利，而马克森斯·拉克鲁瓦率领的法国队则在新任主帅齐达内的带领下前往土耳其。两场国家联赛比赛均于晚上 7.45 开始。距离切尔西女足对阵阿森纳的比赛仅剩最后一天，我们将为您带来更多赛前准备，为蓝桥度过一个重要的下午做好准备。其中将包括露西·布朗兹、斯乔克·努斯肯和劳伦·詹姆斯关于伦敦之争重要性的言论。切尔西队也可能会在温布利球场亮相，届时科尔·帕尔默和摩根·罗杰斯率领的英格兰队将于晚上 7 点 45 分在国家联赛中迎战西班牙队。斯坦福桥伦敦德比日！切尔西女足将在女子超级联赛中迎战阿森纳，比赛将于下午 4.30 开球。门票仍然可以购买，而如果您无法前往大桥，英国的支持者可以通过天空体育观看比赛直播，或者您也可以与我们一起关注比赛。切尔西官方应用程序和网站上的切尔西女足对阵阿森纳比赛中心将为您带来赛前准备、球队新闻和每分钟更新，以及终场哨响后的比赛报告和反应。国际赛事也有：哈托的荷兰队将于下午 5 点访问塞尔维亚，内托队的葡萄牙队将于晚上 7 点 45 分客场迎战挪威。

news.title: Bompastor on Potter and Walsh’s almost telepathic understanding
news.title_zh: 庞帕斯特谈波特和沃尔什近乎心灵感应的理解
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor has praised the almost telepathic understanding developing between Lexi Potter and Keira Walsh, believing their connection is helping Chelsea build from midfield. Knowing where your team-mate will be before you look up is a valuable quality for any midfielder. In Potter and Walsh, Bompastor sees a pair whose awareness of one another is already making an impression. Our Academy graduate has the opportunity to learn alongside one of the world’s best midfielders, and the Chelsea head coach believes their partnership is bringing the best out of their shared confidence on the ball. ‘They have a great connection together,’ Bompastor explained. ‘They understand each other, and even when they are on the pitch and they close their eyes, they know where each other are. So it’s really good. ‘I think they are both really strong and confident with the ball. It’s good to have two players in those positions who are able to bring the ball higher up the pitch and help the team to build up. ‘As I said, I think Lexi is doing well. Keira is a really important player as well for us, the way we want to play and the impact she brings into the game.’ That ability to move us forward is central to what Bompastor wants from her midfield. Walsh’s quality and experience make her an important figure in that approach, while Potter continues to show she can make a significant contribution of her own. The youngster provided another example during Saturday’s 2-0 win over Birmingham City at Stamford Bridge, opening the scoring to set us on the way to three points. Yet it is what Potter delivers from game to game, rather than any single moment, that has particularly impressed her head coach. ‘With Lexi being a young player, what I’m most impressed with is that she’s always consistent with her performances, and at this level, that’s really, really important,’ Bompastor continued. ‘She was able to score a great goal today, and she’s really performing well. She deserves to play.’
news.body_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯托赞扬了莱克西·波特和凯拉·沃尔什之间近乎心灵感应的默契，相信他们的联系正在帮助切尔西建立中场。对于任何中场球员来说，在抬头之前就知道队友会在哪里，这是一项宝贵的品质。在《波特和沃尔什》中，邦帕斯特看到一对对彼此的认识已经给人留下了深刻的印象。我们的青训毕业生有机会与世界上最好的中场球员之一一起学习，切尔西主教练相信他们的合作关系正在充分发挥他们对球的共同信心。 “他们之间有着很好的联系，”邦帕斯特解释道。 “他们互相理解，即使他们在球场上闭上眼睛，他们也知道彼此在哪里。所以这真的很好。 “我认为他们都非常强壮并且对球充满信心。在这些位置上有两名球员能够将球带到更高的位置并帮助球队建立起来是件好事。 “正如我所说，我认为莱克西做得很好。对我们来说，凯拉也是一位非常重要的球员，她是我们想要的比赛方式，也是她给比赛带来的影响。”这种推动我们前进的能力是邦帕斯特对中场的要求的核心。沃尔什的品质和经验使她成为这一方法中的重要人物，而波特则继续表明她可以做出自己的重大贡献。周六在斯坦福桥2-0战胜伯明翰城的比赛中，这名年轻球员再次为球队首开纪录，帮助我们取得三分。然而，令她的主教练印象特别深刻的是波特在一场又一场比赛中的表现，而不是任何一个时刻。 “莱克西是一名年轻球员，给我印象最深的是她的表现始终保持一致，在这个水平上，这真的非常非常重要，”邦帕斯特继续说道。 “她今天打进了一个精彩的进球，她的表现真的很好。她值得上场比赛。

news.title: Sjoeke Nusken: Everyone will have a part to play
news.title_zh: Sjoeke Nusken：每个人都可以发挥作用
news.body_en: Sjoeke Nusken believes the impact of Chelsea’s substitutes against Birmingham City underlined the importance of our whole squad as we prepare to begin our Women’s Champions League campaign this week. With European football returning and big games against Arsenal and Lyon on the horizon, there will be plenty of opportunities for players to make their mark in the weeks ahead. Melvine Malard did exactly that at Stamford Bridge on Saturday, coming off the bench to score our second goal in a 2-0 victory over Birmingham. For Nusken, the forward’s contribution was a timely reminder of the difference fresh legs can make. ‘It’s really important,’ she explained when asked about having players like Malard to call upon. ‘You can always see when they’re coming on that they bring more energy onto the pitch, and that’s what we need. ‘We have a long season ahead, so everyone is needed.’ Lexi Potter’s early opener had given the Blues the advantage, but despite creating a series of chances, we had to wait until the second half for Malard to provide some breathing space. The forward was introduced in the 63rd minute and found the net eight minutes later, helping us secure three points in front of our home supporters. ‘Playing here at Stamford Bridge with the fans was amazing,’ Nusken reflected. ‘I think we created a lot of chances, had good opportunities, and we are happy with the 2-0 win. ‘It was a little bit tight when we were winning 1-0, so it was our aim to get another goal. It was really good when Mel came in. It was such a good game from her, and a goal from her, so it was really good.’ Attention now turns to Europe, with Austria Vienna our opponents at Plough Lane on Wednesday evening as we begin the league phase of the Women’s Champions League. We then return to Stamford Bridge to face Arsenal on Sunday in the WSL and with Lyon also among the challenges to come, it is an exciting spell for the Blues, and Nusken is eager to get our European campaign under way. ‘We are happy to play Champions League again,’ she said. ‘We can’t wait to get it started.’
news.body_zh: 舍克·努斯肯认为，切尔西替补球员对阵伯明翰城的比赛突显了我们整支球队的重要性，因为我们正在准备本周开始女子冠军联赛。随着欧洲足球的回归以及对阵阿森纳和里昂的大型比赛即将到来，球员们将有很多机会在未来几周内留下自己的印记。周六，梅尔文·马拉德在斯坦福桥就做到了这一点，在 2-0 战胜伯明翰的比赛中替补出场打进了我们的第二个进球。对于努斯肯来说，这位前锋的贡献及时提醒了我们新腿可以带来的改变。当被问及是否需要像马拉德这样的球员时，她解释道：“这真的很重要。” “你总是可以看到，当他们上场时，他们会给球场带来更多的能量，而这正是我们所需要的。 “我们还有一个漫长的赛季，所以每个人都需要。”莱克西·波特的早期揭幕战为蓝军带来了优势，但尽管创造了一系列机会，我们还是不得不等到下半场让马拉德提供一些喘息的空间。这名前锋在第 63 分钟登场，八分钟后进球，帮助我们在主场球迷面前锁定三分。 “在斯坦福桥与球迷一起踢球真是太棒了，”努斯肯回忆道。 “我认为我们创造了很多机会，拥有很好的机会，我们对2-0的胜利感到高兴。 “当我们1-0获胜时，比赛有点紧张，所以我们的目标是再进一个球。梅尔上场的时候真是太棒了。她的比赛非常精彩，她的进球也非常出色。”然后我们将返回斯坦福桥，周日在 WSL 中对阵阿森纳，里昂也是即将到来的挑战之一，这对蓝军来说是一个令人兴奋的时期，努斯肯渴望让我们的欧洲联赛开始。 “我们很高兴再次参加冠军联赛，”她说。 “我们迫不及待地想开始。”

news.title: Your Star of the Match vs Birmingham City revealed!
news.title_zh: 您对阵伯明翰城的比赛之星揭晓！
news.body_en: It was another three points for the Blues on Saturday afternoon as we beat Birmingham City 2-0, and users of the Chelsea Official App have decided on their Star of the Match! Goals from Lexi Potter and Melvine Malard helped Chelsea beat Birmingham City 2-0 at Stamford Bridge, taking our tally to seven points from our opening three Women’s Super League fixtures. The Blues made an impressive start and took the lead after eight minutes. Ellie Carpenter burst into the box and picked out Alyssa Thompson, whose flick was saved by Sophie Baggaley. Potter reacted quickest to fire the rebound high into the net. We continued to create chances, with Thompson shooting narrowly over and Carpenter twice threatening. Despite registering 14 attempts to Birmingham’s one before the interval, Sonia Bompastor’s side had to settle for a slender advantage at the break. Thompson went close again after the restart, while Hannah Hampton intervened to deny Wilma Leidhammar an equaliser. Substitute Malard then provided breathing space in the 71st minute, pouncing on hesitation over a backpass to finish from close range. Malard almost turned provider for fellow substitute Maika Hamano as we looked for a third, before Hampton dealt with a late Birmingham free-kick to protect her clean sheet. Fans have been voting for their standout performer since Saturday's match and now we can deliver you the results! Kadiesha Buchanan's solid performance in the heart of our defence saw her take eight per cent of the vote, while Malard's finish and all-round display saw the striker receive 17 per cent. Academy graduate Potter took 29 per cent of your votes but users of the Chelsea Official App agreed with the broadcasters and named Carpenter our Star of the Match with the Australia international receiving 47 per cent of the vote.
news.body_zh: 周六下午，蓝军以 2-0 击败伯明翰城，又拿下三分，切尔西官方应用程序的用户已经选出了他们的比赛之星！莱克西·波特和梅尔文·马拉德的进球帮助切尔西在斯坦福桥以 2-0 击败伯明翰城，使我们在前三场女足超级联赛中的积分达到了 7 分。蓝军开局令人印象深刻，八分钟后取得领先。埃莉·卡彭特冲进禁区，挑出了艾莉莎·汤普森，后者的动作被索菲·巴格利救出。波特反应最快，将篮板射入网内。我们继续创造机会，汤普森的投篮稍稍高出，卡彭特两次威胁。尽管在中场休息之前，伯明翰队有 14 次射门，但索尼娅·邦帕斯特的球队在中场休息时不得不以微弱优势接受。汤普森在重新开始后再次接近，而汉娜·汉普顿介入阻止威尔玛·莱德哈玛扳平比分。第71分钟，替补出场的马拉德提供了喘息的机会，他在一次回传中犹豫不决，近距离射门得分。当我们寻找第三个球员时，马拉德几乎成为了替补队员滨野麦卡的提供者，随后汉普顿处理了伯明翰最后时刻的任意球以保护她的不失球。自周六比赛以来，球迷们一直在投票选出表现出色的球员，现在我们可以向您提供结果！卡迪莎·布坎南 (Kadiesha Buchanan) 在我们后防核心的出色表现让她获得了 8% 的选票，而马拉德 (Malard) 的射门和全能表现让这位前锋获得了 17% 的选票。学院毕业生波特获得了 29% 的选票，但切尔西官方应用程序的用户同意广播公司的观点，并将卡彭特评为本场比赛之星，而这位澳大利亚国脚获得了 47% 的选票。

news.title: Levi Colwill on using the international break to 'become a better team'
news.title_zh: 列维·科尔威尔谈利用国际比赛日“成为一支更好的球队”
news.body_en: No player wants to enter an international break – let alone one that lasts for three weeks – on the back of a defeat. Yet Levi Colwill believes those remaining with the Blues must use it as an opportunity to 'become a better team' under Xabi Alonso. The opening weeks of the campaign have brought contrasting emotions for Chelsea players, staff and supporters alike. Entertaining victories have been recorded while progress has been made in the Carabao Cup, but there have also been disappointing defeats. Friday night's trip to Brentford was one of the latter. Alonso's side started well at the Gtech Community Stadium and controlled the opening 45 minutes, yet things unravelled in the second period as the Bees struck three times without reply. After our opening five top-flight matches, the Blues have claimed seven points. Naturally, that leaves room for improvement, which Colwill is acutely aware of. The 23-year-old, who missed most of last season due to a knee injury, has not been included in the England squad for their upcoming UEFA Nations League fixtures. It means he will remain with the Blues and continue working with Alonso during the international break, something he is not taking for granted. When asked to reflect on our start to the campaign, and the improvements we can make, the Academy graduate said: '[There have been] some good bits, some other not so good bits. 'Luckily we’ve got a while now to try and improve. Hopefully, we will come out the other side flying, pick up our play, and become a better team.'
news.body_zh: 没有球员愿意在一场失利后进入国际比赛日，更不用说持续三周的国际比赛日了。然而，列维·科尔威尔相信那些留在蓝军的人必须利用它作为一个机会，在哈维·阿隆索的带领下“成为一支更好的球队”。赛季开始的几周给切尔西球员、工作人员和球迷带来了截然不同的情绪。卡拉宝杯取得了进步，取得了令人兴奋的胜利，但也有令人失望的失败。周五晚上前往布伦特福德的旅程就是后者之一。阿隆索的球队在 ​​Gtech 社区体育场开局良好，并控制了开场 45 分钟，但在第二节比赛中，蜜蜂队三度进攻却没有任何反击，情况出现了崩溃。在我们的前五场顶级联赛比赛之后，蓝军已经拿下了七分。当然，这留下了改进的空间，科尔威尔敏锐地意识到这一点。这位23岁的球员因膝伤缺席了上赛季的大部分比赛，他没有入选英格兰队即将举行的欧洲国家联赛的大名单。这意味着他将留在蓝军，并在国际比赛日期间继续与阿隆索合作，他并不认为这是理所当然的。当被要求反思我们的活动开始以及我们可以做出的改进时，这位学院毕业生说：“[有]一些好的方面，也有一些不太好的方面。 “幸运的是，我们现在有一段时间来尝试和改进。希望我们能够从另一边飞翔，恢复我们的表现，成为一支更好的球队。

news.title: Ellie Carpenter on contributing to the attack and getting the job done
news.title_zh: 艾莉·卡彭特 (Ellie Carpenter) 讲述了此次袭击并完成了工作
news.body_en: After earning the Player of the Match trophy in our 2-0 win over Birmingham City, Ellie Carpenter explained why she’s enjoying her more attacking role in the side this season. The right wing-back took 16 touches in the opposition box throughout the contest – more than any other Chelsea player – and was delighted with the afternoon’s result. ‘It feels really nice to win today,’ said Carpenter. ‘The most important thing was a home win, the three points and a clean sheet. ‘Birmingham came out strongly, especially in the second half. We had to defend a lot there, but I'm proud of the team that we kept a clean sheet, and we kept to the game plan.' The Australia international has garnered praise for her all-round performances this season, and she has a theory about why she has been standing out. ‘I'm just trying to bring my best every game and also every day in training to help this team achieve our goals,’ she explained. ‘Obviously, I’m now in my second season here at Chelsea, and in London, so I’m feeling a bit more comfortable and getting a little bit of a different role in this formation. ‘It allows me to get forward and attack a little bit more, so I’m really enjoying that freedom.’ After securing the three points at Stamford Bridge, Carpenter was keen to praise team-mate Melvine Malard, who she previously played with at Lyon, for scoring the goal that gave us some much-needed breathing space with 20 minutes to play. Malard was brought on as a 63rd-minute substitute to make her first appearance for Chelsea in the Women’s Super League, and within eight minutes of coming on, she bagged her first league goal for her new club too. ‘We got that important second goal with Melvine,’ Carpenter continued. ‘I’m very happy for her to have her first minutes in the WSL for Chelsea and her first goal, so it's great for her, and also great for the team. ‘We always want to score more goals. But the fact that we're creating the goals and the goalscoring opportunities is good for us. Hopefully we can build on that. We have Champions League in midweek, and obviously Arsenal next weekend. If we keep playing well, performing well and creating those chances, I'm sure the goals will come.’ Chelsea Women investor Alexis Ohanaian was in attendance at Stamford Bridge on Saturday alongside his wife Serena Williams and their two daughters. Carpenter was asked about her opinion of stars from other sports watching her and her team-mates play at the Bridge, and her response showed her passion for women athletes lifting each other up. ‘I think it's amazing,’ she smiled. ‘Women's sport in general is massive, and it’s great to see different athletes and legends at the game. It's really cool to have Serena present and bringing the vibes.’ Don't miss our huge London derby clash against Arsenal at Stamford Bridge! Secure your seat now...
news.body_zh: 在我们 2-0 战胜伯明翰城的比赛中获得全场最佳球员奖杯后，埃莉·卡彭特解释了为什么她在本赛季更喜欢在球队中担任进攻角色。这位右翼卫在整场比赛中在对方禁区内触球 16 次，比其他任何切尔西球员都多，他对下午的结果感到很高兴。 “今天获胜的感觉真的很好，”卡彭特说。 “最重要的是主场胜利、三分和零失球。 “伯明翰表现强劲，尤其是在下半场。我们在那里必须进行很多防守，但我为球队保持不失球而感到自豪，并且我们遵守了比赛计划。”这位澳大利亚国脚本赛季的全面表现赢得了赞誉，她对自己为何能够脱颖而出有自己的一套理论。 “我只是尽力在每场比赛以及每天的训练中发挥出最好的水平，帮助这支球队实现我们的目标，”她解释道。 “显然，现在是我在切尔西和伦敦的第二个赛季，所以我感觉更舒服了，并且在这个阵型中扮演了一些不同的角色。 “这让我能够向前推进，进攻更多，所以我真的很享受这种自由。”在斯坦福桥拿下三分后，卡彭特热衷于赞扬她之前在里昂并肩作战的队友梅尔文·马拉德，他的进球让我们在比赛还剩 20 分钟时获得了急需的喘息空间。马拉德在第 63 分钟替补上场，这是她在女足超级联赛中首次代表切尔西出场，在上场后的八分钟内，她也为新俱乐部打进了第一个联赛进球。 “我们和梅尔文一起打进了重要的第二个进球，”卡彭特继续说道。 “我很高兴她能在切尔西女足联赛中上场，并打进第一个进球，这对她来说很棒，对球队来说也很棒。 ‘我们总是想进更多球。但事实上，我们正在创造进球和进球机会，这对我们来说是有好处的。希望我们能够以此为基础。周中我们有欧冠联赛，下周末当然还有阿森纳。如果我们继续打好比赛，表现出色并创造机会，我相信进球就会到来。”切尔西女足投资者亚历克西斯·奥哈纳扬周六与他的妻子塞雷娜·威廉姆斯和他们的两个女儿一起出席了斯坦福桥球场。卡彭特被问及对其他运动明星观看她和队友在桥上比赛的看法，她的回答表明了她对女运动员互相帮助的热情。 “我觉得这太棒了，”她微笑着说。 “总的来说，女子运动规模很大，很高兴在比赛中看到不同的运动员和传奇人物。有塞雷娜在场并带来这种氛围真是太酷了。不要错过我们在斯坦福桥对阵阿森纳的伦敦德比大战！赶紧抢座位吧……

news.title: PL2 report: Cobham Next Gen 3-1 Fulham
news.title_zh: PL2 报道：科巴姆下一代 3-1 富勒姆
news.body_en: Cobham Next Gen came from behind to beat Fulham on Saturday afternoon, with Harrison Bettoni and Reggie Watson turning the game around early in the second half before Leo Black produced a fine finish to seal the points. Chelsea dominated much of the opening period and struck the woodwork twice through Chizaram Ezenwata and Black, with Fulham goalkeeper Dino Kaiser repeatedly called upon to keep the Blues at bay. Fulham had threatened on the counter throughout the afternoon and that was how they took the lead five minutes before the interval. Dan Casey cut inside with two Chelsea players in pursuit before finding the bottom corner with a right-footed finish. The Blues continued to create opportunities after the restart and were level seven minutes into the second half. Ezenwata showed good awareness to feed Watson, who squared the ball for Bettoni to stroke a left-footed finish into the net. Just three minutes later, Chelsea were ahead. Mahdi Nicoll-Jazuli – fresh from his senior Blues debut – picked out Watson, who cut inside before firing a right-footed effort into net for his fifth goal of the season and first from open play. Chelsea continued to look the more threatening side, with Nicoll-Jazuli going close again before the decisive third arrived with 13 minutes remaining. Ezenwata was again involved, showing excellent awareness to find Black inside the area. The defender turned beautifully before finding the bottom corner with a composed finish to make it 3-1. Black had earlier struck the crossbar and his goal capped an impressive individual display, while Ezenwata's contribution included hitting the post and providing the assist for the third. The result extends Cobham Next Gen's winning run in Premier League 2 to three matches, following victories over West Ham United and Arsenal. Fulham had started the day unbeaten in the competition, having collected seven points from their opening three fixtures. Cobham Next Gen's next scheduled fixture is in the EFL Trophy, when we travel to face Reading on Tuesday 13 October. news.body_zh: 周六下午，科巴姆下一代队后来居上击败富勒姆，哈里森·贝托尼和雷吉·沃森在下半场一开始就扭转了局面，随后里奥·布莱克打出精彩射门锁定比分。切尔西在开局的大部分时间里占据了主导地位，并通过奇扎拉姆·埃森瓦塔和布莱克两次击中门框，富勒姆门将迪诺·凯泽多次呼吁阻止蓝军。富勒姆整个下午都在反击中形成威胁，这就是他们在中场休息前五分钟取得领先的原因。丹·凯西内切，两名切尔西球员紧追不舍，然后右脚射门破门。蓝军在比赛重新开始后继续创造机会，下半场第7分钟扳平比分。埃森瓦塔（Ezenwata）表现出了良好的意识，为沃森（Watson）喂球，沃森（Watson）将球摆正，贝托尼（Bettoni）左脚射门入网。仅仅三分钟后，切尔西就领先了。马赫迪·尼科尔-贾祖利——刚刚完成蓝军首秀——选中了沃森，沃森切入内线，然后右脚射门入网，这是他本赛季的第五个进球，也是第一个空战进球。切尔西继续看起来更具威胁性，尼科尔-贾祖利在比赛还剩 13 分钟时，决定性的第三球到来之前再次逼近。缘渡再次介入，表现出了出色的在区域内寻找黑棋的意识。这名后卫漂亮地转身，然后冷静地射门破门，将比分改写为3-1。布莱克早些时候击中了横梁，他的进球为他令人印象深刻的个人表现画上了圆满的句号，而埃森瓦塔的贡献包括击中门柱并为第三个进球提供助攻。继战胜西汉姆联队和阿森纳队之后，这一结果将科巴姆下一代在英超第二场的连胜纪录扩大到三场。富勒姆在当天的比赛中保持不败，在前三场比赛中获得了七分。 Cobham Next Gen 的下一场比赛是 EFL Trophy，我们将于 10 月 13 日星期二对阵雷丁。切尔西：弗雷迪·伯纳尔、利奥·布莱克、阿尔菲·奥斯本（丹特·韦特 86）、贾斯汀·奥萨吉、奥鲁塔约·苏布洛耶、雷吉·沃森、哈里森·贝托尼（肯德里·佩兹 63）、哈里森·麦克马洪、奇扎拉姆·埃森瓦塔、迈赫迪·尼科尔-贾祖利、索尔·戈登（马蒂斯·埃布埃 80） 未上场替补：卡尔文·迪亚基特、艾萨克·科林森、希泽家·格里姆韦德、刘易斯·理查兹、杰克·默里得分：哈里森·贝托尼 52、雷吉·沃森 55、利奥·布莱克 78 黄牌：阿尔菲·奥斯本 47 经理：哈里·哈德森 富勒姆：迪诺·凯泽、马利·克拉克（纳齐姆·本柴塔 72）、洛根·库克、马库斯·戈明斯、布拉德利·斯莱德、Chibuzo Nwoko、塞斯·钦瓦罗(塔雷尔·卡维尔 86)、麦考利·泽帕 (托马斯·奥利奥特 72)、杰登·夸希、丹·凯西、乔纳·库西-阿萨雷 (何塞·萨尼 72) 未上场替补：马修·巴戈特、马多克斯·扎伊丹·琼斯、阿奇·泰勒 得分手：丹·凯西 35黄牌：塞斯·钦瓦罗、马利·克拉克、Chibuzo Nwoko

news.title: Sonia Bompastor delivers Lauren James injury update and reflects on Birmingham win
news.title_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特 (Sonia Bompastor) 通报劳伦·詹姆斯 (Lauren James) 伤情最新情况并反思伯明翰的胜利
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor has explained the reason behind Lauren James' absence from the squad in our 2-0 victory over Birmingham City at Stamford Bridge on Saturday afternoon. After scoring in our first two Women's Super League matches of the season, LJ was not named in the squad against Birmingham City, and Bompastor explained the reason for her absence. 'In our last training session, she just got a knock,' said the head coach. 'She will probably be out of the game on Wednesday, but we are hoping for her to be back next weekend. 'I am a manager who really wants my team to work with a lot of intensity. We work hard, and the duels are sometimes important in training, but also the intensity. We work a lot on the counter-press. I'm asking my players to come on the pitch and do their best and bring a lot of energy. 'So in this environment, if you want to be able to win this league, you want to also be able to win the Champions League; you need to work at your maximum intensity. And when you are demanding like this with the players, especially when they play every three days, injuries can happen. 'Every team gets injuries. It's more about how you perform when you have injured players, and how long they need to be able to return to the pitch. That's the thing we are focusing on right now to make sure when we have an injury, we optimise the performance and the recovery for them to get back on the pitch as soon as possible without taking high risks.' Goals from Lexi Potter and Melvine Malard secured a 2-0 win against Birmingham, but the goals were spaced out by almost an hour. Our first was netted after just eight minutes, and Bompastor explained that until Malard doubled the lead, she was concerned Birmingham might find a way back into the contest like Aston Villa did in the first match of the season. 'I think we all felt the same,' she continued. 'Probably we all were thinking about our first opening game here. I'm really pleased with the performance again. We dominated and controlled the game for the most part of the 90 minutes. 'Probably we lost a little bit of control starting the second half in the first 10 or 15 minutes, but we scored an early goal and started strong. I think we could've been winning 2-0 or 3-0 at half-time, because we created enough. 'With Melvine, we were able to score the second goal, and it was a real relief because when you score the second goal, you can manage the game in a different way. I'm pleased with the performance and the result at the end.' Don't miss our huge London derby clash against Arsenal at Stamford Bridge! Secure your seat now...
news.body_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯托解释了周六下午我们在斯坦福桥 2-0 战胜伯明翰城的比赛中劳伦·詹姆斯缺席的原因。在本赛季前两场女足超级联赛进球后，LJ 没有入选对阵伯明翰城的大名单，邦帕斯托解释了她缺席的原因。 “在我们的最后一次训练中，她刚刚受到了撞击，”主教练说。 “她可能会缺席周三的比赛，但我们希望她下周末能回来。 “我是一名真正希望我的团队高强度工作的经理。我们努力训练，有时训练中的对抗很重要，但强度也很重要。我们在反压力方面做了很多工作。我要求我的球员上场并尽最大努力并带来大量能量。 “所以在这种环境下，如果你想赢得联赛冠军，你也希望能够赢得欧冠联赛；你需要以最大强度工作。当你对球员提出这样的要求时，尤其是当他们每三天比赛一次时，受伤的情况就会发生。 “每支球队都会受伤。更重要的是当你有球员受伤时你的表现，以及他们需要多长时间才能回到球场。这就是我们现在关注的事情，以确保当我们受伤时，我们优化表现和恢复，让他们尽快回到球场，而不需要承担高风险。”莱克西·波特和梅尔文·马拉德的进球帮助伯明翰 2-0 获胜，但两粒进球相差近一个小时。我们的第一个进球在仅仅八分钟后就取得了进球，邦帕斯特解释说，在马拉德将领先优势扩大一倍之前，她担心伯明翰可能会像阿斯顿维拉在本赛季第一场比赛中那样找到重返比赛的方法。 “我想我们都有同样的感觉，”她继续说道。 “也许我们都在考虑我们在这里的第一场揭幕战。我对再次的表现感到非常满意。我们在90分钟的大部分时间里统治并控制了比赛。 “下半场一开始，我们可能在前 10 或 15 分钟就失去了一点控制权，但我们很早就取得了进球，并且开局强劲。我认为我们本可以在半场以 2-0 或 3-0 获胜，因为我们创造了足够的机会。 “有了梅尔文，我们能够打进第二个进球，这真的让人松了一口气，因为当你打进第二个进球时，你可以用不同的方式管理比赛。我对最终的表现和结果感到满意。不要错过我们在斯坦福桥对阵阿森纳的伦敦德比大战！赶紧抢座位吧……

news.title: Match Report: Chelsea 2-0 Birmingham City
news.title_zh: 比赛战报：切尔西 2-0 伯明翰城
news.body_en: Goals from Lexi Potter and Melvine Malard secured a professional 2-0 victory over Birmingham City at Stamford Bridge on Saturday afternoon. Another day, another strong start to a match from Chelsea. We flew out of the blocks once again when Lexi Potter was alive to a rebound off a save from an Alyssa Thompson shot, putting us ahead at the Bridge after eight minutes. Birmingham dug in from that point and provided a couple of dangerous moments on the break, but we defended those well as we went in at half-time with a one-goal advantage. Second-half substitute Melvine Malard put the contest beyond doubt with 20 minutes to play, capitalising on a Birmingham defensive error. This was a good day at the Bridge, with the three points secured before we face Arsenal here next Sunday. Sonia Bompastor made just two alterations to her starting line-up, bringing in Veerle Buurman and Sandy Baltimore for Katie McCabe and Lauren James. The match began with a cross each from Baltimore and Carpenter, as we showed our intent to penetrate the Birmingham penalty area at the earliest opportunity. And the breakthrough came after just eight minutes, as Carpenter burst through into the box from the right-hand flank, beating the full-back and crossing to Thompson whose clever flicked needed saving. When the ball broke to Potter near the penalty spot, the midfielder opened our account with a superbly struck effort high into the back of the net. After a short spell of Birmingham attacks, we went forward once more. Thompson sent her attempt just over the bar, and with 30 minutes gone, another dangerous ball in from Baltimore was almost steered home by Carpenter from six yards out. We continued to push for more, and when Thompson crossed from the right, Sjoeke Nusken hit the bar with a header, but it wouldn't have counted as the flag went up for offside. A fast break from Wieke Kaptein saw the midfielder lay the ball off to Carpenter on the right, and the Australian proceeded to sting the goalkeeper's gloves with a powerful drive. The half ended with our 14 shots as opposed to just one from Birmingham, but there was more work to do after the interval. Thompson went close again soon after the restart and was denied a spot-kick when she was brought down in the penalty area when one-on-one with goalkeeper Sophie Baggaley. Up the other end, only a quick intervention from Hannah Hampton prevented Wilma Leidhammar from netting an equaliser from close range. On came striker Melvine Malard in place of Baltimore as we looked to capitalise on our advantage, and Maika Hamano was also introduced shortly afterwards. And as the visitors went close with a shot that went just wide of the post, we rushed forward from a Hampton goal-kick, and Malard capitalised on a moment's hesitation on a pass back to Baggaley to convert from close range. As the minutes ticked towards full-time, Malard played a ball across the box for Hamano, but the Japan international couldn't quite connect with the cross. With the points seemingly secure, Bompastor took the opportunity to make a triple substitution, swapping Nathalie Bjorn, Giulia Dragoni and Katie McCabe for Kadeisha Buchanan, Nusken and Thompson. Hampton palmed away a ball that flew into the box from a Birmingham free-kick in stoppage time, preserving the clean sheet after a professional display from Chelsea. We earn our first win at Stamford Bridge since making it our new permanent home in the summer, sending our fans home happy. We have gained seven points from our opening three WSL matches this season We play the first game in the league phase of the Women's Champions League, as we take on Austria Vienna at Plough Lane on Wednesday evening, before returning to Stamford Bridge next Sunday for our London derby against Arsenal. news.body_zh: 周六下午，莱克西·波特和梅尔文·马拉德的进球帮助球队在斯坦福桥以 2-0 战胜伯明翰城。又一天，切尔西队的比赛又取得了强劲的开局。当莱克西·波特（Lexi Potter）在阿丽莎·汤普森（Alyssa Thompson）的射门扑救中抢到篮板时，我们再次飞出了禁区，八分钟后我们在桥上取得了领先。伯明翰从那时起就开始反击，并在中场休息时创造了几个危险的时刻，但我们很好地防守了这些时刻，半场结束时我们以一球的优势进入了比赛。下半场替补梅尔文·马拉德利用伯明翰队的防守失误，在比赛还剩 20 分钟时让比赛变得毫无悬念。这是蓝桥美好的一天，我们在下周日在这里对阵阿森纳之前已经拿到了三分。索尼娅·邦帕斯特只对她的首发阵容进行了两次调整，用维尔勒·布尔曼和桑迪·巴尔的摩替换了凯蒂·麦凯布和劳伦·詹姆斯。比赛开始时，巴尔的摩和卡彭特分别传中，我们表现出了尽早突破伯明翰禁区的意图。仅仅八分钟后，突破就出现了，卡彭特从右侧突入禁区，击败了边后卫，传中给汤普森，汤普森的巧妙射门需要扑救。当球传到点球点附近的波特手中时，这位中场球员以一脚精彩的射门破门得分。在伯明翰的短暂进攻之后，我们再次前进。汤普森的射门稍稍高出横梁，30分钟过去了，巴尔的摩的另一个危险球差点被卡彭特在六码外击中。我们继续进攻，当汤普森从右路传中时，斯乔克·努斯肯头球击中横梁，但由于越位，所以这不算在内。维克·卡普坦 (Wieke Kaptein) 快速突破，将球传给右侧的卡彭特 (Carpenter)，澳大利亚人用强力的射门刺痛了守门员的手套。上半场结束时，我们射门 14 次，而伯明翰只射门 1 次，但中场休息后还有更多工作要做。比赛重新开始后不久，汤普森再次接近，但在禁区内与门将索菲·巴加利一对一时被撞倒，被拒绝点球。在另一端，只有汉娜·汉普顿的快速干预才阻止威尔玛·莱德哈马尔近距离扳平比分。当我们希望利用我们的优势时，前锋梅尔文·马拉德取代了巴尔的摩，不久之后也引进了滨野舞香。当客队的一脚射门稍稍偏出门柱时，汉普顿开出球门球，我们冲上前去，马拉德利用短暂的犹豫，将球回传给巴加利，近距离射门。随着比赛时间的临近，马拉德在禁区为滨野传出一脚传球，但这位日本国脚未能接应传中。在积分看似稳稳的情况下，邦帕斯特趁机进行了三次换人，用纳塔莉·比约恩、朱莉娅·德拉格尼和凯蒂·麦凯布换下卡德莎·布坎南、努斯肯和汤普森。汉普顿在补时阶段将伯明翰任意球飞入禁区的球挡出，在切尔西的专业表现后保住了不失球。自从夏天把斯坦福桥作为我们的新永久主场以来，我们在斯坦福桥赢得了第一场胜利，让我们的球迷高兴回家。我们在本赛季 WSL 的前三场比赛中获得了 7 分。我们将进行女子冠军联赛联赛阶段的第一场比赛，周三晚上我们将在普劳巷迎战奥地利维也纳，然后下周日将返回斯坦福桥参加对阵阿森纳的伦敦德比。切尔西：汉普顿、卡彭特、布尔曼、布坎南（比约恩 87）、青铜（c）、努斯肯（德拉戈尼 87）、波特、卡普坦（滨野 73）、沃尔什、巴尔的摩（马拉德 63）、汤普森（麦凯布 87）未上场替补：彭、鲁兹、吉尔马、拉斯得分手：波特 8、马拉德 71伯明翰城：巴格利，莱维塞尔，李（天野66），纳尔松德，莱德哈马尔，克罗斯韦特，麦肯纳，特纳（中），赫特雷，宫川，赫伦未使用的替补：托马斯，哈里斯，拉斯托克莱，库克，霍洛威，科内特，埃法埃法，萨里出席人数：4,793裁判：爱丽丝帕克不要错过我们巨大的伦敦斯坦福桥对阵阿森纳的德比战！赶紧抢座位吧……

news.title: Under-18 Premier League report: Chelsea 5-0 Bournemouth
news.title_zh: 18岁以下英超联赛报告：切尔西5-0伯恩茅斯
news.body_en:
Chelsea Under-18s recorded a second successive victory in the Under-18 Premier League as Jashayde Greenwood, Isaac McGillvary, Jacob Dako, Eden Perez and an own goal secured a 5-0 win over Bournemouth at Cobham.
 The Blues took control during the first half, with Greenwood and McGillvary finding the net before the interval. Bournemouth were reduced to ten men early in the second half when Kelvin Arthur was shown a straight red card for a challenge on Dako, who then converted the resulting free-kick. Perez added a fourth before a deflection off Jake Drewett completed the scoring. Chelsea had the first sight of goal after three minutes when Lewi Richards shot over from the centre of the box. Andrew Pennie then tested Bournemouth goalkeeper William Upstell, who saved the midfielder's effort from outside the box before holding Dako's follow-up. The breakthrough arrived in the 14th minute. Greenwood held up Toby Bell’s long pass, picked out Gabriel Sambou who slipped in the striker. He burst clear and finished right-footed into the bottom-left corner to put the young Blues ahead. Bournemouth continued to threaten from distance, but Chelsea doubled our advantage in the 26th minute. Pennie provided the set-up for McGillvary, who made no mistake from the centre of the box. Greenwood went close to adding another before the break, while Pennie was also denied by Upstell. Richards then rose highest from a corner in stoppage time but headed just over. Chelsea continued to press after the restart, with Pennie seeing another effort saved before one of the game's decisive moments arrived in the 56th minute. Dako, racing clear on goal, was caught by a challenge from Bournemouth substitute Kelvin Arthur. He was shown a straight red card with the foul having taken place just outside the box. Dako dusted himself down and took responsibility for the resulting free-kick, thumping a right-footed effort into the top-left corner to make it 3-0. The Blues continued to create opportunities and added a fourth in the 71st minute. Dako squared for Perez, who walked the ball in from close range. There was time for a fifth, as substitute Bilal Shah drove into the box and saw his effort take a hefty deflection off Drewett to complete the scoring. The result gives Chelsea a fourth league victory of the season and leaves the young Blues with 12 points from six Under-18 Premier League matches. It is also a second consecutive league win at Cobham following last month's 6-1 victory over Reading. Chelsea Under-18s will return to action on Saturday 10 October, when we welcome Manchester United to Cobham in the Under-18 Premier League Cup. Chelsea: Toby Bell, Lewi Richards, Gabriel Sambou, Dante Waite, Jacob Hall, Isaac Badu Da Silva, Eden Perez, Jacob Dako, Jashayde Greenwood, Isaac McGillvary, Andrew Pennie (Bilal Shah 78) Unused subs: Isaac Collinson, Jake Murray, Josh Henry, Kwamina Ampah Scorers: Greenwood 14, McGillvary 26, Dako 58, Perez 71, Drewett own goal 78 Manager: Dan Hogan Bournemouth: William Upstell, Harley Simpson, Aidan Batista Guanchez (Kelvin Arthur 45), Joe Spence, Zach Sutton, Damani Kearney, Jake Drewett (Fikayo Solanke 86), Tom Stuckey (Max Collins 36), Adrian Oluwande (Tom Robinson 62), Leyland Waite, Denzel Decardi-Nelson (Kian Symmans 62) Unused subs: Zach Melin, Rafferty Vavasour Sent off: Kelvin Arthur 56 Manager: James Lowy
news.body_zh:
切尔西 U-18 队凭借贾沙德·格林伍德、艾萨克·麦吉尔瓦里、雅各布·达科、艾登·佩雷斯和乌龙球，在科巴姆以 5-0 战胜伯恩茅斯，取得了 U-18 英超联赛的二连胜。
 蓝军在上半场占据主动，格林伍德和麦吉尔瓦里在中场休息前进球。下半场一开始，伯恩茅斯队就只剩下十人了，凯尔文·阿瑟因为对达科犯规而被直接出示红牌，随后达科主罚任意球。佩雷斯 (Perez) 打进第四球，随后杰克·德鲁伊特 (Jake Drewett) 的一次偏转完成得分。三分钟后，刘易·理查兹从禁区中央射门，切尔西队首次进球。安德鲁·佩尼随后测试了伯恩茅斯门将威廉·厄普斯特尔，后者在禁区外扑出了中场球员的射门，然后又抓住了达科的跟进。第14分钟，突破到来。格林伍德接住了托比·贝尔的长传，挑出了插上前锋的加布里埃尔·桑布。他突然突破，右脚射入左下角，帮助年轻的蓝军取得领先。伯恩茅斯继续进行远距离威胁，但切尔西在第 26 分钟将优势扩大一倍。彭尼为麦吉尔瓦里提供了传球机会，麦吉尔瓦里在禁区中央没有犯任何错误。格林伍德在中场休息前差点再添一球，而彭尼也被Upstell拒绝了。伤停补时阶段，理查兹从角球处起脚射门，但头球稍稍高出。比赛重新开始后，切尔西继续施压，佩尼的另一次射门被扑出，比赛的决定性时刻之一在第 56 分钟到来。达科冲向球门，但遭到伯恩茅斯替补凯尔文·阿瑟的挑衅。由于犯规发生在禁区外，他被直接出示红牌。达科拍拍身上的灰尘，主罚任意球，右脚射门左上角，比分变为3-0。蓝军继续创造机会，并在第71分钟再添第四个机会。达科（Dako）为佩雷斯（Perez）摆出姿势，佩雷斯近距离将球送入。比赛还剩第五个进球的时候，替补出场的比拉尔·沙阿（Bilal Shah）冲入禁区，他的射门被德鲁伊特（Drewett）严重偏转，完成得分。这一结果让切尔西获得了本赛季的第四场联赛胜利，这支年轻的蓝军在 6 场 U-18 英超联赛中积 12 分。这也是科巴姆继上个月6-1战胜雷丁后连续第二场联赛获胜。切尔西 18 岁以下青年队将于 10 月 10 日星期六重返赛场，届时我们将迎来曼联前往科巴姆参加 18 岁以下英超联赛杯比赛。切尔西：托比·贝尔、刘易斯·理查兹、加布里埃尔·桑布、丹特·维特、雅各布·霍尔、艾萨克·巴杜·达席尔瓦、伊登·佩雷斯、雅各布·达科、贾沙伊德·格林伍德、艾萨克·麦吉尔瓦里、安德鲁·彭尼（比拉尔·沙阿 78）未上场替补：艾萨克·科林森、杰克·穆雷、约什·亨利、夸米纳·安帕 进球者：格林伍德 14、麦吉尔瓦里 26、达科 58、佩雷斯 71、德鲁伊特乌龙球 78 主教练：丹·霍根 伯恩茅斯：威廉·厄普斯特尔、哈雷·辛普森、艾丹·巴蒂斯塔·关切斯（凯尔文·亚瑟 45）、乔·斯彭斯、扎克·萨顿、达马尼·科尔尼、杰克·德鲁伊特（菲卡约·索兰克 86）、汤姆·斯塔基（马克斯·柯林斯 36）、阿德里安·奥卢万德（汤姆·罗宾逊） 62), Leyland Waite, Denzel Decardi-Nelson (Kian Symmans 62) 未上场替补：扎克·梅林，拉弗蒂·瓦瓦苏尔 被罚下场：凯尔文·亚瑟 56 经理：詹姆斯·洛伊

news.title: Confirmed Chelsea Women line up vs Birmingham City
news.title_zh: 确认切尔西女足对阵伯明翰城的阵容
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor has made three changes to her Chelsea starting XI for our WSL clash against Birmingham City at Stamford Bridge this afternoon. We take on Amy Merricks' side following our resounding 5-0 victory away at Manchester United last weekend, and we go in search of another three points in the Women's Super League this lunchtime. Veerle Buurman comes into the defence in place of Katie McCabe, and Sandy Baltimore replaces Lauren James as Bompastor rotates her side with a packed schedule in mind. Chelsea Academy graduate Lexi Potter retains her place in the starting XI after drawing praise from Bompastor after her performance against Manchester United. As confirmed in Bompastor's pre-match press conference, trio Nathalie Bjorn, Naomi Girma and Melvine Malard have returned to fitness and are all named on today's bench. news.title: The day Jimmy Greaves captained the Blues - and scored four!
news.title_zh: 吉米·格里夫斯 (Jimmy Greaves) 担任蓝军队长的那一天 - 并攻入四球！
news.body_en: On the fifth anniversary of the great Jimmy Greaves' death, we tell the story of the day he captained Chelsea for the first and only time, saying his farewells in the way he knew best... ‘They carried me off like I were the FA Cup.’ In 1961, the Italian Football Association lifted a ban that forbid its teams signing foreign footballers. Almost immediately some of Serie A’s giants turned an interested eye in the direction of England, where players’ earning potential was at that point still capped by the maximum footballers’ wage - £20 a week. Jimmy Greaves was Chelsea’s star man and our chairman Joe Mears knew he was hot property. The youngest man to score 100 league goals, a record that stands to this day, Greaves’s extraordinary goalscoring touch never wavered from the moment he marked his first team debut with an equaliser in a 1-1 draw at Tottenham in August 1957. His performance that day left quite an impression on the esteemed journalist Charles Buchan, writing for the News Chronicle. ‘Only 17 years old, Greaves showed the ball control, confidence and positional strength of a seasoned campaigner. It was the finest first-ever League game I have seen from any youngster.’ As consistent as Greaves was in front of goal, the defence behind him struggled to keep opponents at bay, ruining any chance we had of lifting silverware. In his autobiography Greaves singles out a meek FA Cup exit at home to Fourth Division Crewe in January 1961 as particularly jarring, helping intensify his desire to move away from SW6. Mears knew Greaves’ value and was not afraid to sell, although ideally he would not transfer to a fellow English club, so when AC Milan came calling a deal was quickly struck. The forward’s final game for the club was our final match of the 1960/61 season, at home to Nottingham Forest. Greaves was named as captain to honour his phenomenal efforts in a blue shirt (pictured top, left), and he signed off in the way only he knew how to, by finding the back of the net – four times! Chelsea won a thriller 4-3, and it was the perfect way for the Stamford Bridge hero to bow out. That was his 13th Chelsea hat-trick – and his sixth of that season alone - and after the game he was carried off the pitch on the shoulders of adoring supporters, pictured below. At White Hart Lane 64 years ago, Greaves stepped on the field as a Chelsea player for the first time, against a team he would later represent for over eight years. After the match the Times newspaper observed of the 17-year-old prodigy that ‘Greaves may have a rich future’. Little did they know just how rich it would be, with Greaves' legacy as one of English's football's finest long secured.
news.body_zh: 在伟大的吉米·格里夫斯逝世五周年之际，我们讲述了他第一次也是唯一一次担任切尔西队长的那一天的故事，并以他最熟悉的方式进行了告别……“他们把我带走了，就像我带走了足总杯一样。”1961年，意大利足协取消了一项禁止其球队签下外籍球员的禁令。几乎立刻，一些意甲豪门就将感兴趣的目光投向了英格兰，当时英格兰球员的收入潜力仍然受到球员最高工资——每周 20 英镑的限制。吉米·格里夫斯是切尔西的明星球员，我们的主席乔·米尔斯知道他是炙手可热的人物。格里夫斯是联赛中打入 100 粒进球最年轻的球员，这一纪录至今仍保持着。从 1957 年 8 月在 1-1 战平托特纳姆热刺队的比赛中扳平比分，完成一线队首秀的那一刻起，格里夫斯非凡的进球手感就从未动摇过。那天他的表现给《新闻纪事报》撰稿的受人尊敬的记者查尔斯·巴肯留下了深刻的印象。年仅 17 岁的格里夫斯就展现出了一名经验丰富的球员所具备的控球能力、自信和位置优势。这是我所见过的年轻人中最精彩的首场联赛。”尽管格里夫斯在门前表现稳定，但他身后的防守却很难阻止对手，毁掉了我们举起奖杯的任何机会。格里夫斯在他的自传中特别指出，1961 年 1 月足总杯主场输给第四级联赛克鲁队的那场比赛特别令人震惊，这更加强烈了他离开 SW6 的愿望。米尔斯知道格里夫斯的价值，并且并不害怕出售，尽管理想情况下他不会转会到其他英国俱乐部，所以当AC米兰打电话时，交易很快就达成了。这位前锋为俱乐部效力的最后一场比赛是我们 1960/61 赛季的最后一场比赛，主场对阵诺丁汉森林。格里夫斯被任命为队长，以表彰他身着蓝色球衣（上​​图左）所做出的非凡努力，他以只有他知道的方式结束了比赛，四次进球！切尔西以 4-3 惊险获胜，这是这位斯坦福桥英雄的完美谢幕方式。这是他在切尔西的第 13 次帽子戏法，也是他那个赛季的第六次帽子戏法。赛后，他被崇拜的支持者的肩膀抬出了球场，如下图所示。 64 年前，在白鹿巷球场，格里夫斯首次以切尔西球员的身份踏上赛场，对手是一支他后来效力了八年多的球队。赛后《泰晤士报》评论了这位17岁的神童，“格里夫斯可能有一个美好的未来”。他们几乎不知道这将是多么富有，因为格里夫斯作为英格兰足球最优秀的球员之一的遗产早已得到保障。

news.title: Levi Colwill accepts there is a 'lot to work on' after Brentford defeat
news.title_zh: 列维·科尔威尔承认布伦特福德失利后还有“很多工作要做”
news.body_en: Disappointment was etched across the face of Levi Colwill as he undertook the post-match media duties following our 3-0 defeat at Brentford. It was a result, as our captain for the night admitted, that hurt. The final scoreline didn't necessarily reflect Chelsea's performance at the Gtech Community Stadium. We controlled much of the opening period, limiting Brentford to just one shot on target despite a barrage of long throw-ins. We had created a couple of opportunities of our own, with Caoimhin Kelleher denying Pedro Neto and Morgan Rogers, who also had a late first-half attempt blocked on its way to goal. As the players emerged for the second half, the game was delicately poised. Unfortunately, it tipped the way of the hosts. Jaidon Anthony headed home just after the hour mark, Igor Thiago then netted, and Fabio Carvalho put gloss on Brentford's victory in stoppage time. It was a disappointing evening for the Blues. Colwill, who skippered the side in Reece James' absence due to injury, was honest in his reflection on the performance. He accepted the second-half display was not good enough, and that there must be an improvement defensively. ‘It was tough,' the 23-year-old explained. 'First of all, conceding from a set-piece isn’t the best, and then we tried to push and maybe over-exposed ourselves and played some passes we shouldn’t and forced it. 'I feel we needed to relax and not push too hard for the equaliser; we needed to believe it would come if we continued playing our football. But I think we pushed too hard to get it and they hurt us on the counter. 'They get the second goal and then the third goal really hit home and hurt. The second half we weren’t good enough, obviously, and we’ve got a lot to work on during the international break.' For the first time under Xabi Alonso – and the first time this season in all competitions – the Blues failed to find the net. Joao Pedro was also absent due to injury, with the Brazilian replaced by Danny Welbeck, who netted in our previous two Carabao Cup fixtures, in the side. Yet Colwill insisted that, no matter who is deployed in attack, a solid defence is required to give us a platform to win games. He said: 'We can’t rely on the front three to pull us out of danger; the rest of us have to try to help as much as possible. The defence, the midfield and the attackers, we all need to help each other much more. 'We’ve definitely got a lot of room to improve.'
news.body_zh: 在我们0-3输给布伦特福德后，利瓦伊·科尔威尔在承担赛后媒体职责时，脸上写满了失望。正如我们当晚的队长所承认的那样，这个结果令人痛苦。最终比分并不一定反映切尔西在 Gtech 社区体育场的表现。我们控制了开局的大部分时间，尽管有大量的长界外球，但限制了布伦特福德只有一脚射中目标。我们自己创造了几次机会，曹伊欣·凯莱赫挡出了佩德罗·内托和摩根·罗杰斯的射门，后者在上半场最后时刻的射门也被挡出。下半场，随着球员们陆续登场，比赛陷入了微妙的平衡。不幸的是，它改变了东道主的方式。一小时后杰登·安东尼头球破门，伊戈尔·蒂亚戈进球，法比奥·卡瓦略在补时阶段为布伦特福德的胜利锦上添花。对于蓝军来说，这是一个令人失望的夜晚。科尔威尔在里斯·詹姆斯因伤缺席期间担任球队队长，他对球队的表现诚实地进行了反思。他承认下半场的表现不够好，防守方面必须有所改进。 “这很艰难，”23 岁的他解释道。 “首先，定位球丢球并不是最好的，然后我们试图逼抢，也许过度暴露了自己，并传出了一些我们不应该传球的传球，并强迫传球。 “我觉得我们需要放松，不要太用力去扳平比分；我们需要相信，如果我们继续踢足球，它就会到来。但我认为我们太努力了，他们在柜台上伤害了我们。 “他们进了第二个球，然后第三个球真的击中了要害并伤害了他们。显然，下半场我们表现得不够好，在国际比赛日期间我们还有很多工作要做。”在哈维·阿隆索的带领下，蓝军第一次未能进球，这也是本赛季在所有比赛中第一次。若奥·佩德罗也因伤缺席，巴西人被丹尼·维尔贝克顶替，他在我们之前两场卡拉宝杯比赛中进球。但科尔威尔坚持认为，无论谁在进攻中部署，都需要坚实的防守才能为我们提供赢得比赛的平台。他说：“我们不能依靠前三名来把我们从危险中拉出来；我们其他人必须尽力提供​​帮助。后防线、中场和前锋，我们都需要更多地互相帮助。 “我们肯定还有很大的改进空间。”

news.title: Alonso: ‘It’s not about talking or looking for excuses’
news.title_zh: 阿隆索：“这不是谈论或寻找借口”
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso felt his Chelsea team were punished for not being able to maintain the required levels to compete against Brentford over the course of 90 minutes, with our manager stressing he is not ‘looking for excuses’ for the defeat. The Blues were the better team before the interval, but the Bees took charge in the second period and broke the deadlock through Jaidon Anthony on the hour. We tried to muster a response, yet our hosts made sure of the result with two late goals, leaving Alonso to reflect on a second defeat so far this season. ‘I’m disappointed at the end with the second half and the result,’ he said. ‘This is not enough to compete in the Premier League, not to be able to go for the 90 minutes. This is why today we were punished. ‘At the moment, we are not being consistent enough to compete during the whole game – 45 [minutes] is not enough, you need to play the whole game knowing each detail is important and each action can be decisive. ‘We dropped our consistency, and our competitive mentality needed in the second half. It's about 95 minutes, and we have not been able to keep that level throughout these few games in the start of the season. It's something that we'll have to do better.’ Alonso had to make do without his captain, Reece James, and arguably our top performer so far this season, Joao Pedro. Both were ruled out because of injury. But our manager was at pains to not use the duo’s absence to explain away the result at the Gtech Community Stadium. ‘It’s not about talking or looking for excuses,’ said Alonso. ‘We need to look at each other and know we have to work and improve. 'There is still a long way to go, but we have to check many things.’
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索认为他的切尔西队因无法在 90 分钟内保持与布伦特福德的比赛所需的水平而受到惩罚，我们的主教练强调他并没有为失败“寻找借口”。蓝军在中场休息前表现更好，但蜜蜂队在第二节占据主导地位，并在比赛结束时通过杰登·安东尼打破了僵局。我们试图做出回应，但我们的东道主在最后时刻的两个进球确保了结果，让阿隆索反思了本赛季迄今为止的第二场失利。 “我对下半场的结束和结果感到失望，”他说。 ‘这不足以参加英超联赛，无法踢满 90 分钟。这就是今天我们受到惩罚的原因。 “目前，我们在整场比赛中的稳定性还不够——45分钟是不够的，你需要打整场比赛，知道每个细节都很重要，每个动作都具有决定性。” “我们失去了稳定性，也失去了下半场所需的竞争心态。大约是95分钟，我们在赛季初的这几场比赛中都没能保持这个水平。这是我们必须做得更好的事情。”阿隆索不得不在没有他的队长里斯·詹姆斯和可以说是我们本赛季迄今为止表现最好的球员若昂·佩德罗的情况下生存。两人均因伤缺席。但我们的经理煞费苦心地不利用两人的缺席来解释 Gtech 社区体育场的结果。 “这不是谈论或寻找借口，”阿隆索说。 “我们需要互相审视，知道我们必须努力并改进。 “还有很长的路要走，但我们必须检查很多事情。”
