news.title: Match report: Brentford 3-0 Chelsea
news.title_zh: 比赛战报：布伦特福德 3-0 切尔西
news.body_en: Three second-half goals condemned Chelsea to defeat at the Gtech Community Stadium in our final fixture before the international break. Chelsea were the better side in the opening 45 minutes, with Pedro Neto drawing an excellent save from Caoimhin Kelleher and Morgan Rogers having a goalbound shot blocked. However, it was Brentford who came out the blocks faster following the interval and they scored what felt like it would be a pivotal opener through Jaidon Anthony’s close-range header on the hour. As we pressed for an equaliser, we were caught on the break late on. Igor Thiago doubled the Bees lead and Fabio Carvalho made it 3-0 with virtually the last kick, condemning us to a first defeat at the Gtech Community Stadium. Xabi Alonso made five alterations to his side, handing Jordan Henderson a Chelsea debut and three other players their first start in the Premier League. Pep Chavarria, Valentin Barco, and Danny Welbeck were all included in the XI, with Maxence Lacroix the other fresh face in the side. Two of the changes were enforced, with Reece James and Joao Pedro unavailable, while Malo Gusto, Jorrel Hato and Romeo Lavia dropped to the bench. They were joined there by 16-year-old Mahdi Nicoll-Jazuli, who was named in a matchday squad for the first time and would come on to make his Blues debut. A crackling Friday night atmosphere greeted the teams and after a brief spell of Brentford pressure, we began to assert our dominance on the contest. Cole Palmer danced his way into the box but was eventually crowded out before he could shoot. Chavarria was a regular outlet down our left and from one cross in the tenth minute, Welbeck teed up Pedro Neto. His first-time shot was well saved by Kelleher. By the midway point of the half, we had limited the home side’s threat to a handful of set-pieces and long throws, passing the test on every occasion. The Blues were mixing up our attacks, using width on occasion but also allowing Rogers to drift infield and link up with Palmer. It was from a central position that our no.17’s goalbound shot – from Chavarria’s intelligent pass – hit Jannik Schuster and fizzed behind. It had not been an opening 45 minutes full of opportunities, but this unfamiliar Chelsea side could certainly be satisfied with their efforts as the teams headed down the tunnel with it all still to play for. The second half started in similar fashion: keenly contested, but with space in the final third at a premium. Brentford improved, too, and five minutes in, Emi Martinez got the feintest of touches on an Anthony header that hit the top of the crossbar, but the offside flag was up anyway. Not long after, our keeper launched a counter-attack with a diagonal pass that Chavarria latched on to. He opted to shoot and though Kelleher was worried, the ball flew wide. Brentford went straight up the other end and scored. Damsgaard’s corner from the left was met by Schuster, who headed back across goal for an unmarked Anthony to nod into the net from a couple of yards out. We very nearly levelled matters up from a corner of our own. Henderson’s vicious delivery was missed by Kelleher but the ricochet didn’t quite land in our favour, with the Bees smuggling the ball clear. Our hosts twice looked threatening on the break but couldn’t make the most of their men over, and then we really started to ramp up the pressure, pinning Brentford back and winning corner after corner. From one, Barco had a good appeal for a penalty waved away, with his attempt one of several in quick succession that were met by a red-and-white shirt flinging themselves in the line of fire. We had five shots blocked between the 66th and the 80th minute. But it was Brentford who got the game’s second goal. Schade was set free and though Martinez did excellently to save his shot, the rebound fell to Thiago who couldn’t miss. Alonso brought Nicoll-Jazuli on for his senior debut late on, and there was still time for Brentford to extend their lead, Carvalho firing home at the far post after Schade’s cross had been deflected kindly into his path. The Blues remain on seven points with five league games played. A prolonged international break that lasts until the second week of October. We return to action on Saturday 10 October when Bournemouth come to the Bridge. news.body_zh: 下半场的三个进球让切尔西在国际比赛日之前的最后一场比赛中在 Gtech 社区体育场失利。开场 45 分钟，切尔西表现较好，佩德罗·内托 (Pedro Neto) 精彩扑救考伊欣·凯莱赫 (Caoimhin Kelleher)，摩根·罗杰斯 (Morgan Rogers) 的射门被挡出。然而，布伦特福德在中场休息后更快地完成了拦网，他们通过杰登·安东尼(Jaidon Anthony)的近距离头球破门得分，感觉这将是一个关键的揭幕战。当我们力争扳平比分时，我们在中场休息时陷入了困境。伊戈尔·蒂亚戈 (Igor Thiago) 扩大了蜜蜂队的领先优势，而法比奥·卡瓦略 (Fabio Carvalho) 在最后一脚将比分改写为 3-0，这让我们在 Gtech 社区体育场遭遇了首场失利。哈维·阿隆索对球队进行了五次调整，乔丹·亨德森在切尔西首次亮相，其他三名球员则在英超联赛中首次首发。佩普·查瓦里亚、瓦伦丁·巴尔科和丹尼·维尔贝克都入选了首发阵容，马克森斯·拉克鲁瓦是另一位新面孔。其中两项调整被强制执行，里斯·詹姆斯和若昂·佩德罗无法上场，而马洛·古斯托、乔雷尔·哈托和罗密欧·拉维亚则坐在替补席上。 16 岁的迈赫迪·尼科尔-贾祖利 (Mahdi Nicoll-Jazuli) 也加入了他们的行列，他首次入选比赛日大名单，并在上场后首次亮相蓝军。星期五晚上，各支球队的气氛热烈，在短暂的布伦特福德压力之后，我们开始确立我们在比赛中的统治地位。科尔·帕尔默跳进禁区，但最终在射门之前就被挤了出去。查瓦里亚是我们左路的常规出路，第十分钟的一次传中，维尔贝克将佩德罗·内托送入球门。他的第一次射门被凯莱赫成功扑出。到半场中段时，我们将主队的威胁限制在少量的定位球和长传上，每次都通过了考验。蓝军混合了我们的进攻，有时使用宽度，但也让罗杰斯漂移到内场并与帕尔默联系。我们的 17 号球员从中间位置射门——查瓦里亚巧妙的传球——击中了扬尼克·舒斯特尔并在身后嘶嘶作响。开场的 45 分钟并不是充满机会的，但这支陌生的切尔西队肯定会对自己的努力感到满意，因为球队即将进入隧道，一切仍有待争夺。下半场以类似的方式开始：争夺激烈，但最后三分之一的空间非常宝贵。布伦特福德也有所进步，五分钟后，埃米·马丁内斯接到安东尼的头球击中横梁顶部，但越位旗还是举了起来。不久之后，我们的门将发起反击，斜传球被查瓦里亚接住。他选择射门，尽管凯莱赫很担心，但球飞出了边线。布伦特福德直接冲上另一端得分。达姆斯加德从左侧开出角球，舒斯特尔接到球门后回传球，无人盯防的安东尼在几码外头球入网。我们差点就从自己的一个角落里把事情搞平了。亨德森的恶毒传球被凯莱赫错过，但跳弹并没有完全对我们有利，蜜蜂队将球偷偷清除。我们的东道主两次在中场休息时看起来很有威胁，但无法充分利用他们的球员，然后我们开始加大压力，将布伦特福德压制住，赢得一个又一个角球。从一开始，巴科就曾多次提出点球请求，但被判无效，他连续几次尝试都被红白相间的球衣扔进了火线中，这是他的一次尝试。从第 66 分钟到第 80 分钟，我们有 5 次射门被挡出。但布伦特福德打进了比赛的第二个进球。沙德被释放，尽管马丁内斯出色地扑出了射门，但篮板球落到了蒂亚戈身上，蒂亚戈投篮不中。阿隆索在晚些时候让尼科尔-贾祖利上场，完成了他的成年队首秀，布伦特福德还有时间扩大领先优势，在沙德的传中被巧妙地偏转到他的路径上后，卡瓦略在远门柱射门。蓝军在进行了五场联赛后仍积七分。长期的国际假期将持续到十月的第二周。 10 月 10 日星期六，伯恩茅斯将造访蓝桥，我们将重返赛场。 切尔西（4-2-3-1）：马丁内斯；福法纳（Acheampong 71）、拉克鲁瓦、科尔威尔（c）、查瓦里亚；亨德森，巴可（Nicoll-Jazuli 87）；内托 (Estevao 87)、帕尔默、罗杰斯；维尔贝克 (Quenda 71) 未上场替补：彭德斯、古斯托、哈托、拉维亚、吉滕斯 布伦特福德 (4-3-3)：凯莱赫；卡约德（希基 69）、阿耶尔、舒斯特、刘易斯-波特（迪乌夫 81）；亚莫柳克 (Sangare 69)、贾内特 (c)、达姆斯加德 (Carvalho 87)；安东尼（瓦塔拉 81）、蒂亚戈、沙德未使用替补：巴尔科姆、亨​​利、威尔逊、弗雷德里克得分手：安东尼 61、蒂亚戈 83、卡瓦略 90+4 黄牌：蒂亚戈 84、桑加雷 85 裁判安德鲁·马德利·克劳德 17,193

news.title: Xabi Alonso on 'competitive monster' Jordan Henderson and Chelsea absentees
news.title_zh: 哈维·阿隆索谈乔丹·亨德森和切尔西缺席的“竞争怪物”
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso has described Jordan Henderson as a 'competitive monster' after handing the midfielder his Chelsea debut at Brentford and explained why Reece James and Joao Pedro are absent this evening. Henderson joined the Blues on a free transfer this summer, but his Blues bow has been delayed due to the broken arm he sustained while away with England at this summer's FIFA World Cup. The 36-year-old has diligently undertaken his recovery at Cobham over the past six weeks and is now ready to make his Chelsea debut – and it comes against the club with whom he spent the previous campaign. On including Henderson in his side against Brentford, Alonso said: ‘The Premier League is about competing and Jordan is a competitive monster. 'I’m sure he will help the team with his quality, his game intelligence and the communication he has. We’re happy to have him back.' Alonso has been unable to call upon several players at the Gtech Community Stadium, with James and Joao Pedro joining Marco Palestra, Moises Caicedo and Emmanuel Emegha on the sidelines. 'Reece picked up a little injury in the last game against Hull and was feeling short in his recovery,' Alonso explained ahead of tonight's game. 'Joao we tried, but we expect to use the international break for him to be back in the next game against Bournemouth.' The Brazilian's absence means Danny Welbeck makes his full Premier League debut for the Blues, and will form part of an attack that includes Cole Palmer and Morgan Rogers. 'You need to adapt to the qualities of the players and get the benefit of what they do well,' Alonso explained when asked what Welbeck will offer as part of our front three. 'We know Danny is a reference and links very well. He is intelligent and knows where to play, and if we have a front three that works well it will be better for the team.'
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索在乔丹·亨德森在布伦特福德完成切尔西首秀后将其描述为“有竞争力的怪物”，并解释了里斯·詹姆斯和若昂·佩德罗今晚缺席的原因。亨德森今年夏天免费转会加盟蓝军，但由于他在今年夏天随英格兰队参加世界杯时手臂骨折，他的蓝军出场时间被推迟。过去六周里，这位 36 岁的球员在科巴姆努力康复，现在已经准备好在切尔西首次亮相，而且对手是他上赛季效力的俱乐部。在将亨德森纳入球队对阵布伦特福德的比赛中，阿隆索表示：“英超联赛就是竞争，而乔丹是一个有竞争力的怪物。 “我确信他会凭借自己的能力、比赛智慧和沟通能力为球队提供帮助。我们很高兴他回来了。”阿隆索无法在 Gtech 社区体育场召唤几名球员，詹姆斯和若昂·佩德罗加入了马科·帕莱斯特拉、莫伊塞斯·凯塞多和伊曼纽尔·埃梅加的行列。 “里斯在上一场对阵赫尔城的比赛中受了点伤，感觉恢复时间很短，”阿隆索在今晚的比赛前解释道。 “我们尝试过若昂，但我们希望利用国际比赛日让他在下一场对阵伯恩茅斯的比赛中回归。”巴西人的缺席意味着丹尼·维尔贝克将在蓝军的英超联赛中首次亮相，并将成为包括科尔·帕尔默和摩根·罗杰斯在内的进攻的一部分。当被问及维尔贝克作为我们的前三名球员将提供什么时，阿隆索解释道：“你需要适应球员的素质，并从他们的出色表现中获益。” “我们知道丹尼是一个推荐人并且联系非常好。他很聪明，知道在哪里踢球，如果我们有一个运转良好的前场三人组，那对球队来说会更好。”

news.title: Jordan Henderson on making his Chelsea debut at Brentford
news.title_zh: 乔丹·亨德森在布伦特福德完成切尔西首秀
news.body_en: Jordan Henderson has had to wait patiently to make his Chelsea debut. But having recovered from injury, the 36-year-old is in from the start against Brentford tonight and ready to make his mark. Henderson, who spent last season with the Bees, signed for the Blues earlier in the summer on a free transfer. However, having broken his arm while away with England at the FIFA World Cup, his first outing in Blue has been delayed. Tonight at the Gtech Community Stadium, Henderson will step out in a Chelsea shirt for the first time. And the midfielder is looking forward to introducing himself to the Blues faithful. 'Delighted to be back and have the feeling of getting onto the pitch,' Henderson explained ahead of this evening's Premier League clash with Brentford. 'It’s been a while, so I’m just excited to be back. 'It’s been a little frustrating [not being able to play], but I’ve tried to stay as fit as I can to be ready for this opportunity now. I’m just looking forward to it. 'It’s been good to settle in with the team over the last month, even though it’s been frustrating not playing games, but hopefully now I can get involved.' Henderson's illustrious career has seen him play hundreds of games at domestic level, in England and abroad. His last 34 came with Brentford during the 2025/26 campaign, with the England international impressing for the Bees before his departure and eventual switch to Stamford Bridge. It means that Henderson is well-versed in the threat Keith Andrews' side will pose tonight, and has outlined that the Blues will need to perform well to come away with a positive result. He said: 'They’re a fantastic team who can play with the ball, are good on transition and are good in behind. So it will be a very difficult game, as we know, so we’ve got to be 100 per cent to get anything from the game. 'But if we can play the way we know we can, we will cause them problems as well.'
news.body_zh: 乔丹·亨德森必须耐心等待才能完成他的切尔西首秀。但从伤病中恢复后，这位 36 岁的球员在今晚对阵布伦特福德的比赛中首发出场，并准备好留下自己的印记。亨德森上赛季效力于蜜蜂队，今年夏天早些时候以免费转会的方式加盟蓝军。然而，由于他在随英格兰队参加世界杯时摔断了手臂，他在蓝色队的首场比赛被推迟了。今晚在 Gtech 社区体育场，亨德森将首次身着切尔西球衣出场。这位中场球员期待着向蓝军球迷介绍自己。 “很高兴能回来并有上场的感觉，”亨德森在今晚与布伦特福德的英超比赛前解释道。 “已经有一段时间了，所以我很高兴能回来。 “（无法上场）有点令人沮丧，但我已经尽力保持健康，为现在的机会做好准备。我只是期待它。 “过去一个月适应球队的感觉很好，尽管不参加比赛很令人沮丧，但希望现在我能参与其中。”亨德森辉煌的职业生涯见证了他在国内、英格兰和国外踢了数百场比赛。他的最后34场比赛是在2025/26赛季为布伦特福德效力的，这位英格兰国脚在离开并最终转投斯坦福桥之前为蜜蜂队留下了深刻的印象。这意味着亨德森深知基思·安德鲁斯的球队今晚将构成的威胁，并概述了蓝军需要表现出色才能取得积极的结果。他说：“他们是一支出色的球队，能够控球，擅长攻防转换，也擅长后卫。因此，正如我们所知，这将是一场非常困难的比赛，所以我们必须百分百努力才能从比赛中获得任何东西。 “但如果我们能按照我们知道的方式打球，我们也会给他们带来麻烦。”

news.title: Confirmed Chelsea line up vs Brentford
news.title_zh: 确认切尔西对阵布伦特福德的阵容
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso has made five changes to his Chelsea team for today’s fixture away to Brentford, with a quartet of Blues handed their full Premier League debut. Pep Chavarria, Valentin Barco, Jordan Henderson and Danny Welbeck are included in Alonso’s starting XI. Reece James and Joao Pedro are unavailable, while Malo Gusto, Jorrel Hato and Romeo Lavia drop to the bench. The other new face in the side from last weekend’s draw with Hull City is Maxence Lacroix, while Henderson's selection means he makes his Blues debut against the club he represented last season. The bench includes 16-year-old Mahdi Nicoll-Jazuli for the first time in a competitive game.
